tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsung ngag rin po che'i khog phub kyi rnam par bshad pa'i zin bris gnad kyi be bum zab mo bzhugs so/ /dge'o// rnam gsum rgyud don bcud bsdus dza hu'i bu mo'i legs gsung gtam/ /rnam dpyod blo gros spyan stong dbang po'i nor 'dzin las 'ongs legs pa'i lam/ /rnam dag kun bzang lha mchog mkhyen yangs ral pas spyi bor legs par bzung / /rnam kun blo gsal ma dros rgya mtsho'i gang blo'i dbyings su legs par 'khyil/ /e ma ho legs gsung gaṅgā'i rgyun 'di/ /blo gsal gnyis 'thung zhal gyi sgo nas/ /zab gsal dngul gyi bye ma 'dren zhing / /skal ldan shar gyi phyogs 'dir babs so/ /de ltar gsang chen zab mo'i dga' ston las/ /gsung ngag spyi rnam khog phub rin chen rgyan/ /bsdus don gser gyi srad bus rab sbrel nas/ /tshig don ngo mtshar phra tshom spra bzhin du/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung gi chu gter las/ /rang gis ji ltar longs bzhin 'di na ko /de la 'dir gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gang zag 'di la thog mar mkho ba gdam ngag gang las brgyud pa'i brgyud pa dang / brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gsung ngag ji ltar byung ba ngo mtshar ba'i gtam dang bcas pa'i sgo nas khog phub kyi rnam gzhag zhib cing ngo mtshar ba/ yid 'phrog cing dga' ba bskyed pa zhig gsungs na yang / rang nyid blo mi gsal zhing brjed ngas pa ches pa nas cher ma zin mod/ cung zad yid la bcags pa kha yar cig brjed gso tsam du bri ba la/ spyir lo rgyus 'di rnams/ rje btsun rin po che'i bla ma rgya bod kyi lo rgyus gzhir bzhag der mi gsal ba/ dmar gyi zhib mo rdo rje/ bar ston gyi zhib mo rnam 'thag bla ma dam pa'i ngo mtshar snang ba/ rje ngor pa'i chos 'byung bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od rnams kyis kha bskangs/ de rnams su yang mi gsal ba/ zha lu'i lo rgyus chen mo/ spangs rje'i chos 'byung /

'brom lugs kyi chos 'byung / cha rgan gyi rgya bod kyi lo rgyus/ gzhan yang mdzad byang med kyang sa lugs zha lugs sogs kyi lo rgyus kyi dpe rnying / rang rang gi gzhung bshad du 'byung ba'i lo rgyus sogs ngo mtshar ba'i cha shas thams cad lugs so sor ma 'dres shing gsal bar gsungs/ de yang gzhi rje btsun gyi lo rgyus rnam gnyis gdan du bzhag bsdus don gyi 'chad lugs rje rdo rje 'chang gi bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od bzhin legs par gsungs te spyir btang ba'o/ /dmigs kyis bsal ba rang re sa skya pa'i chos 'byung snga ma snga ma rnams su/ cung zad thugs zhib chug ma chug gi rnam pas/ gyi jo la gsung ngag mi bzhugs pa dang / 'brom las 'phel ba med tshul sogs mngon sum gyi bsal ba 'bab nges pa rnams la ni lugs gzhan tshad mar bya dgos pa'i skabs kyang srid pa'o/ /de la 'di nyid ni/ sa lugs sogs cung mi gsal lam snying po'i zhib cha bsdus tsam zhig bris na/ bsdus don nam sa bcad ni/ spyir dam pa'i chos byung tshul/ byung pa'i chos la bshad sgrub bya tshul/ bsgrub pa mthar phyin nas gzhan don bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ rgya gar du byung ba'i tshul dang / bod du byung ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum/ spyir dam chos byung ba'i tshul/ bye brag tu lam skor dgu byung ba'i tshul/ de las khyad par du gsung ngag byung ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rang re'i ston pas dang por sems bskyed de/ bar du tshogs bsags/ tha mar byang chub pa'i tshul bstan cing / de'i bstan pa lo lnga brgya phrag bcur gnas tshul la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bla ma dam pa'i chos 'byung yan chad du gang zag brgyad kyis mdzad pa'i lam skor dgu zhes pa kho na yod kyang / rje rdo rje 'chang gis lo rgyus kyi yi ge la zhib brtags mdzad pas/ nag po pa la gnyis su 'byed dgos pa gsal bar dgongs nas/ chos 'byung bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od man chad/

dpal ldan ngor pa'i rjes 'jug rnams/ /gang zag dgus mdzad pa'i lam skor dgu zhes 'dod de/ de yang / re re la mdzad pa po'i gang zag rgyud dang gzhung gang la brten nas mdzad pa/ gzhung gang mdzad pa/ don nyams len gyi khrid ngos bzung ba dang bzhi bzhis 'chad pa las/ gang zag ni/ rdo rje gdan pa'i grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bstod pa re dang sbyar nas ngos 'dzin te/ chu bo chen po gyen la bzlogs/ /zhes sogs ltar gyi birwa pas spyir bka' mdo rgyud/ bye brag tu bla med/ khyad par du rgyud gsum/ de'i nang nas kyang gtsor brtag gnyis la brten nas/ gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid gsung ngag rin po che'o/ /birwa pa la/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa dang / shar phyogs birwa pa dang / 'di snga ma'o/ /dge slong lus la dngos grub brnyes/ /nags kyi lha mos bdud rtsi phul/ /klu sgrub snying po zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar gyi gang zag 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ rgyud gsang 'dus le'u gnyis pa/ rnam snang byang chub sems le la brten nas/ gzhung byang chub sems 'grel mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid mchod rten drung thob bo/ /rgyal rigs zla ba'i dngos grub brnyes/ /padma can dang lhan cig bzhugs/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar gyi mtsho skyes rdo rjes/ rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa'i brtag gnyis la brten nas gzhung bskyed rim sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo lta bu mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid bskyed rim zab pa'i tshul dgu bsnyen sgrub bzhi cha 'bri ba dang bcas pa'o/ /mtsho skyes la che chung gsum las/ dang po ni yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ 'di de'i slob ma ste bar pa la ngos bzung nas/ bod du byon tshul sogs byed pa gcig rdo rje 'chang gis chos 'byung du gsungs/ rje btsun gyi lam skor gyi lo rgyus kyi yi ge ltar na/

mtsho skyes chung bas bod du byon pa 'thad pa'i phyogs gcig yod gsungs/ gding ba btings nas gaṅgā brgal/ /stag la zhon nas dngos grub brnyes/ /ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka zhes pa'i/ /bla ma… zhes pa ltar gyi ḍoṃ bhi pas/ rgyud brtag gnyis la brten nas gzhung lhan cig skyes grub mdzad/ /nyams len gyi khrid lhan cig skyes pa gsum gyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /ḍoṃ bhi pa la/ ḍoṃ bhi hai ru ka dpal mchog ḍoṃ bhi pa che chung gnyis te gsum las/ 'di dang po'o/ /thar bu'i lus la shing mkhan rigs/ /mu tra ma dang dngos grub brnyes/ /tog tse pa zhes bya ba yi/ /bla ma… zhes pa ltar gyi/ gang zag tog rtse pas/ rgyud sam bhu ṭi la brten nas/ gzhung bsam mi khyab mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid bsam gyis mi khyab pa lngas lam yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rgyal rigs u rgyan gnas na bzhugs/ /lcam sring gnyis kyis dngos grub brnyes/ /ind+ra bhu ti zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma… zhes pa ltar gyi gang zag ind+ra bhu tis/ rgyud ye shes thig le la brten nas/ gzhung dbang yon tan rim pa mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid phyag rgya lam rdzogs so/ /ind+ra bhu ti la che chung gsum las/ 'di bar pa'o/ /de gsum min pa gcig kyang yod gsungs/ bla ma'i bka' bcag spyod pa mdzad/ /srid pa bar dor rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /nag po spyod pa zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma zhes pa ltar gyi gang zag nag po spyod pas/ rgyu bde mchog rtsa bshad la brten nas/ gzhung o la pa ti mkha' 'gro'i brda skad/ bod skad du nag po rim bzhi zhes 'byung ba de mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid gtum mo lam rdzogs so/ /nag po pa la/ nag po spyod pa/ shar phyogs nag po pa/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje/ nag po shan ta bha ṭa la sogs pa mang dag yod pa las/ 'di dang po yin pa sho bzhag go /rgyal rigs nyi ma'i zer la gshegs/ /ril lu mig sman sa 'og spyod/ /ngag dbang grags pa zhes bya ba'i/

/bla ma zhes pa ltar gyi gang zag ngag dbang grags pas/ rgyud brtag gnyis dang gsang 'dus la brten nas/ gzhung bzhi pa snang ba/ yan lag bdun ldan/ de kho na nyid rin chen phreng ba de gsum mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid phyag chen yi ge med pa'o/ /dka' thub bor nas spyod pa mdzad/ /lta stangs mdzad cing dngos grub brnyes/ /nag po pa zhes bya ba yi/ /bla ma zhes pa ltar gyi gang zag nag po u tsi ṭa 'chi ba med pas/ rgyud ma rgyud mtha' dag la brten nas/ gzhung rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig mdzad/ nyams len gyi khrid yon po srong pa'o/ /gsum pa gsung ngag dar tshul ni/ thog mar rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sku che ba'i lo rgyus/ tshul ji ltar dar tshul/ dus nam gyi dus dar tshul rnams ji ltar snyam na/ 'di'i zhib cha zha lugs sogs na gsal/ sa lugs rang na yam me ba las med gsungs/ gang du sku 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ rgya gar shar phyogs bhi ṣaṇṭa sman gyi dbang po zhes bya bar rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu 'khyud ces bya ba'i sras/ rgyal po gser gyi 'khor lo can/ de'i sras rgyal po dngul gyi 'khor lo can yin la/ rgyal po de nyid kyis rgyal srid spangs te bstan pa la zhugs pa ni/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'di nyid yin te/ thog mar so ma pu rir/ mkhan po dul ba'i lha dang / slob dpon rgyal ba grags pa'i dpal las rab tu byung zhing / bstan pa'i bya ba cung zad mdzad nas/ de nas na lend+rar mkhan po dharma mi tra las bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ de nyid kyis mkhan por gsol te bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad la/ mkhan po las rdo rje theg pa'i tshul mnos shing / rdo rje bdag med mas byin gyis brlabs pa nas/ so wa na thar brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa re zhig bsdus pa'i bar phal cher/ rje btsun gyi bla ma brgya'i lo rgyus kyi dkyus bzhin yin la/ der mi gsal ba ngo mtshar ba'i gtam ni/ so wa nā tha'i dbang phyug gis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang de nyid nas/

bro lam tsam gyi sa'i cha/ dgu tsar zhes bya ba'i gnas na/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rdo sku yin yang zer/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug rang yin yang zer/ gang ltar yang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sku zhabs rol pa'i 'dug stangs/ phyag g.yas nyi ma rteng 'dzin/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi mthil na gser 'gyur a ru ra gnam rgyal gyi tshad tsam 'dzin pa/ sku bongs kyi tshad ni 'di zhes mtha' gcig tu gzhal bar mi nus te/ ma dad cing tho 'tshams pas ni mi tshad longs kyis kyang dbu'i gtsug mi rtogs shing / dad cing mchod par 'dun na byis pa chung ngus kyang ci 'dod du rtogs so/ /ming gi khyad par ni/ phyi pa rnams dbang phyug la sogs pa rnams kyi stobs dang bsod nams 'phrog par byed pas/ ba la ha ra'am/ puṇe ha ra zhes 'dogs te/ 'di ma mchod na mi dge ba'i ltas ngan chen po 'byung zer nas cha gsum du bsgos nas mchod pas mchod par byed/ nang pa rnams stobs kyi mgon po yin pas/ ba la na bā zhes 'dod de/ 'di mchod na dngos grub 'byung zer nas mchod par byed de/ spyir rgya gar na/ dus rgyun gyi mchod pa de wi ko ṭa'i khar sa pa ṇi bzang / glo bur gyi mchod pa rdo rje gdan bzang ba yin pa la/ deng sang ni rgyun dang khyad par gyi mchod pa gnyis ka so wa na thā nyid bzang ba yin zhes grags so/ /'khor ni/ grwa ba gcig dang bud med dam khyi mo gcig rgyun du yod de/ phyag na rdo rje dang / rnal 'byor ma yin par grags/ yon tan gyi khyad par ni shin tu che ste/ phyag mthil gyi gser 'gyur gyi rtsis/ lcags la sogs pa ci 'dod du gser du bsgyur nas 'jig rten gyi dbul phongs bsal ba'i sgo nas yun ring du bde bas 'tsho bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de na mod kyi skabs gcig tu/ rgyal po 'dod can gcig gis/ lcags la sogs pa'i yo byad mang po dus gcig tu bsags nas/ bang mdzod gser gyis gang bar 'dod pa'i 'dod rngams tshabs ches pa la brten nas/

phyag par ba bsdams nas sus kyang longs spyod rgyu med pa gcig byung / phyis su gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ phyag gi sbubs na mar/ lcags phra mo btang bas/ reg thub cing gang reg thams cad gser du bsgyur bas 'jig rten gyi 'dod pa bskong ba tsam byung / yang skabs gcig tu/ bram ze gcig gis/ sa sde gtsugs nas gser 'gyur zhus pas/ phyag gi nang gi gser 'gyur gnang nas/ khyod rang ji ltar bzhed pa'i 'dod don sgrub la/ de nas 'di nyid snga ma bzhin du zhog cig ces bsdams/ bram zes rang gi khyim du gser 'gyur mang po byas pas/ yul de'i rgyal pos gsan nas/ pho nya mngags pa na/ bram zes sngar gyi chad byas pa ltar gleng nas rgyal po rang yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyid la zhus na 'thad do byas nas/ pho nya ba dang bcas swa wa na thār phyin pa na/ phyag gi gser 'gyur snga ma bzhin bsdams nas/ rgyal po la ma gnang bas/ rgyal po khros nas tho 'tshams par brtsams pa na/ rgyal po la mi dge ba'i ltas byung nas cher ma nus so/ /gzhan yang rten de nyid kyi zhal du chang blugs pas/ dang por khol zhing / mthar thims pas/ ji tsam pa'i chang blugs kyang khengs pa med pa yod/ kha cig de'i drung du rdo'i kā pā la gcig yod pas/ chang blug sa de nyid yin yang zer/ mdor na/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug de nyid la thim pa'am/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyid yin yang rung ste/ re zhig gling 'dir brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa 'phro bshol te bzhugs pa yin la/ phyis bhi ma sa re'i dbang phyug gi ling ga zhig pa bsdud pa la lan gcig dang / glang po che smyon pa gcig 'dul ba la rnal 'byor pa se ro pa zhes pa gcig byung ste/ de yang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'di nyid yin nam zhes grags pas/ lan gnyis byon pa yin no/ /de dag ni swa wa na tha'i skor cung zad tsam mo/ /mkhan por gsol dang mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs/ /ngan par khas blangs gaṅgās lam yang byin/

/rgyal po btul dang gaṅgā gyen la bzlogs/ /myos byed gsol phyir nyi ma steng pa bzung / /ling ga bkas dang dbang phyug lag nas khrid/ /tsan ṭi btul dang sgrol mas zhal 'gyur dang / /rtogs pa phul dang gdong drug btul ba sogs/ /lo rgyus gzhung dang bla ma'i zhal las shes/ /rje 'brog mi'i gsung rgyud pa las ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge brda zhes sdom brtson 'gyur/ /lho yi phyogs su rnam par grags/ /sdom brtson de bzhin sngags kyang 'grub/ /ces pa 'di rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'di'i lung bstan yin par mdzad de/ 'di'i mtshan dharma pa la yin pas/ ming thog ma bstan pa dang / gaṅgā gyen zlog gnyis pa nas/ tsaṇṭi ka btul ba yan chad/ lho phyogs yin pas/ lho phyogs su rnam par grags pa ches cher che ba dang / sdom brtson gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa dang / rdo rje bdag med mas byin gyis brlabs nas gsang sngags kyi mchog grub pa sogs thams cad ji lta ba bzhin 'grig cing / yongs su grags pa dpal ldan chos grags kyi lung bstan du sbyor ba la ni/ thams cad tshang ba'i nges pa cung zad dka' gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'di dus nam gyi tshe byon nas/ gsung ngag rin po che'i gdams pa spel snyam na/ klu sgrub kyi slob ma ārya de ba/ de'i slob mar 'di nyid/ zhi byed rgyud rim las 'byung ba ltar na/ lo stong lhag dang / thogs med kyi slob rgyud du mdo sde sa bcu pa'i rgyud rim las 'byung ba ltar na/ lo stong nyi shu tsam nas byon pa yin la/ gsung ngag rin po che'i bka' drin thob pa'i slob ma ni gnyis las/ nag po pa nyid gtso bo yin zhing / de nyid las gtso bor 'phel te/ de yang / gaṅgā gyen zlog gnyis pa'i dus kyi ko mkhan rjes su 'brangs pa ni/ ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka ste/ de nyid skal ldan cig car pa yin pas/ de'i lam gyi sgo nas bkris shing /

lam gyi cha shas tsam gyis bdag nyid dang rtogs pa mnyam par gyur nas/ shar phyogs kyi yul sna tshogs sbrang ldan/ pho brang kaṃ ka na'i rgyal po 'dul du btang bas/ sbrul gyi srab mthur byas nas stag mi zan la chibs/ phyag tu sbrul thogs nas rgyal po btul ba sogs mdzad la/ 'di las 'phel ba rtsa ba med pa zhes pa cung zad cig yod de/ deng sang brgyud pa'i phyogs 'di pa 'grel pa lugs su bzhed pa'o/ /ral pa can lnga brgya'i gseb nas gcig rjes su 'brangs pa ni/ shar phyogs nag po pa yin la/ 'di nyid ni skal dman rim 'jug pa ste/ ral pa can lnga brgya'i gseb nas thon ma thag yin pa dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rjes su 'brangs pa yin pas na/ sngar bstan la ma zhugs shing 'jug 'dod yod pa dbang rtul te rdo rje tshig rkang brjed thor gnang ba sogs de'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pas/ rdo rje tshig rkang gnang zhing / de'i doṃ staṃn gyi rim pas bkris pa yin la/ de nyid la brten nas gsung ngag rin po che 'di brgyud mar 'phel ba yin te/ de yang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis grub chen shar phyogs nag po pa la/ yul dbus kyi rgyal po seng ge rnam par rol pa'am/ rlung las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ rdo rje tshig rkang byin la thul/ de yid ches pa'i rgyab rten du/ nub phyogs u rgyan dharma ga tsa ste chos kyi pho brang nas/ rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa'i nang nas/ lung skor sde lnga zhes bya ba yid ches pa'i lung yod pa de spyan drongs zhes lung bstan/ dper na grub chen lo hi pas dha ri ka pa la dpal mngon par rtogs pa gnang nas de'i rgyab rten du/ u rgyan nas mkha' 'gro ma kun spyod kyi rgyud spyan drongs zhes lung bstan nas de bzhin mdzad pa dang 'dra yong / lung skor sde lnga zhes pa ni/ sa lugs la ni sgros gsal ba med/ zha lugs na yang dang yang du 'byung bas/ khong pa la lung sde lnga 'di yin gyi gtad so tsam gcig ni nam yang yod pa yin nam gsungs/

gang ltar yang / de lta bu'i nag po pa de nyid lho phyogs nas 'ongs kyang / yul rgya gar shar phyogs pa yin pas shar phyogs nag po pa zhes bya la/ snyan sha ring bas sam/ yul gyi bye brag karṇa zhes pa la brten nas/ nag po karṇa pa zhes kyang bya ste/ 'di la mgon po sngon byung gi rgyud ltar na/ ka ha na pa zhes pa gcig nges par thob gsungs/ de lta bu'i nag po pas/ rgyal po btsun mo bdun cu rtsa gnyis la chags pa zhig kyang btul te/ dang por btsun mo'i dbus su byon/ btsun mo rnams kyis rgyal po la rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas/ chad pas chod cig gsungs pa la/ rgyal po'i dmag phyir phyin tsa na slob dpon nang du 'ongs/ nang du phyin tsa na phyir 'ongs/ phyi nang gnyis ka dmag gi bkang bas/ slob dpon gyis sprul pa'i dmag je mang btang ste mthar brgya rtsa brgyad du spel bas rgyal pos grub pa thob par shes te zhabs la gtugs pa sogs so/ /de na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ ḍa ma ru pa lung bstan pa bzhin du/ nag po pas/ a ba dhu ti pa/ ḍa ma ru pas ga yā dha ra/ a ba dhu ti pas/ 'brog mi'i bar du lung bstan nas/ gsung ngag rin po che ni gang zag de dag la snyan nas snyan du brgyud de/ gab pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pas/ 'phags pa'i yul du de tsam gyi snyan grags che ba dang 'phel rgyas ches cher spel ba ni ma mdzad de/ mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thol le ba'i gdam ngag bka' mdo rgyud thams cad kyi bcud phyung ba'i snying po'i snying po zab mo 'di ni snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa dang / gcig nas gcig tu 'ongs te/ snod ldan kho na'i spyod yul yin pas so/ /de lta mod kyi/ 'phags yul ba gzhan dag la yang sgros gtan med pa ni ma yin te/ grub chen dpa' bo 'od gsal dang / thub pa byin la sogs pas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lam gyi srol ni 'di lta bu'o zhes ngos bzung ba tsam yod gsungs/ de dag ni 'phags yul du ji ltar spel ba'i lo rgyus te/

rgyud pa gzhan de dag la ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gyi cha shas/ rang gzhan gyi yig cha rnams su/ 'di dang 'di zhes mang po bris pa ni med gsungs/ 'on kyang 'dir thor ma 'khod pa ni mang po zhig rje bla ma gsungs te/ dper na ḍa ma ru pas stag mi zan dang / mu stegs kyi rgyal po gcig phrag la bkal nas/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa rdo rje theg pa la bkod pa sogs so/ /rdo rje 'chang nas ga ya dha ra'i bar 'phags yul gsung ngag 'dzin pa'i brgyud pa bdun/ dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung zab las 'ongs pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi cha shas cung zad do// ༈ //gnyis pa bod du dar tshul la'ang gsum/ spyir bstan pa/ bye brag tu lam skor/ khyad par du gsung ngag dar tshul lo/ /dang po la'ang gsum/ dang por dar tshul/ bar du 'grib tshul/ mtha' mar dar tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bod kyi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa drug pa lha tho tho ri snyan zhal ring la sku gsung thugs kyi rten nam mkha' nas babs pa/ paṇḍi ta blo sems mtsho dang / lo tsā ba li thi se gnyis kyis khur nas 'ongs pas ming gnyan po gsang bar nas mchod pas/ dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga pa srong btsan sgam po'i ngo la dar/ de nas gsum pa khri srong lde'u btsan gyi ngo la/ btags mkhan po bo dhi sa twa/ kā ma la shī la sogs spyan drangs so/ /sad mi bdun sogs rab tu byung / bsam yas sogs bzhengs nas bstan pa shin tu dar ba sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni rgyal po glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa/ de'i thugs la gdon gsol nas/ rten gsum bshig cing / rab byung phab nas bstan pa med pa lo bdun cu'am/ bdun cu rtsa bdun gyi bar byung ba sogs so/ /gsum pa ni gnyis/ smad nas dar ba dang / stod nas dar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ g.yo dmar gtsang gsum gyis/ mdo khams dan tig shel gyi dgon par byon pa las bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/

de las dbus gtsang mi lngas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad pa las/ bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslangs shing / dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba bzhin mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni stod kyi mgon gsum du grags pa'i sras rgyud/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi sku ring la/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma pa la spyan drangs/ pradzña pa la/ ku na pa la/ sa sdu pa la ste/ pa la rnam gsum du grags pa'i dge slong dang / dang po'i mkhan bu/ zhang zhung pa rgyal ba shes rab sogs kyi sgo nas/ 'dul ba stod lugs zhes pa'ang dar mod kyi/ gtso bor bla ma ye shes 'od kyis/ de dus kyi gzhon nu sher brtson ldan pa bdun/ de dag dang cha mthun pa bdun/ de dag gi g.yog bdun te/ nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya gar du chos slob tu btang nas/ gzhan rnams srog gi bar chad du song ba tsam las ma byung yang / lo chen rin bzang dang / lo chung legs shes gnyis kyi sgo nas/ spyir theg pa che chung mtha' dag sgos pha rol tu phyin pa dang / yo ga la sogs pa shin tu dar bar mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa lam skor byung ba'i tshul ni/ spyir gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir/ lam skor dgu po 'di la/ 'gyur dang / bshad pa dang / bsgrub pa'i sgo nas/ lam skor cha re re gnyis gnyis tsam gyi bdag por gyur pa ni mang dag byung yod/ lam skor dgu po thams cad la 'gyur dang bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas gtan la phab cing / bdag nyid chen por gyur pa ni/ bla chen 'brog mi 'di nyid kho na yin la/ de yang gang zag gang las/ tshul ji ltar gsan snyam na/ gang zag ni bzhi las gsan te/ rje ga ya dha ra la/ gsung ngag rin po che/ padma'i lam rdzogs/ gtum mo lam rdzogs/ yon po srong ba ste bzhi gsan/ dpa' bo rdo rje la/ mchod rten drung thob/ lhan cig skyes grub/ bsam mi khyab ste gsum gsan/ a mo gha badzra las/ phyag rgya lam rdzogs gsan/ shes rab gsang ba la yi ge med pa gsan pa yin no/

/tha ma 'di la a tsa ra dmar po zhabs su yang grags so/ /gsum pa gsung ngag rin po che byung tshul la gsum/ dang po ga ya dha ras srol btod tshul/ bar du 'brog mis spel tshul/ mthar rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyis dar rgyas su mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po ni spyir rje ga ya dha ras bod du lan bzhi byon zhes zha lugs pa rnams 'dod la/ sa lugs na lan gsum byon pa tsam la yam mes bzhag yod gsungs/ lan bzhi byon tshul yang mi mthun pa du ma 'dug kyang thog mar grub chen a ba dha ti pas/ ga ya dha ra la/ spyan ras gzigs kyis lung bstan pa'i lo tsā ba/ chu bo lo ho siṃ'i 'gram/ rgyal po'i mchod gnas su gyur pa zhig yod pa de la/ lam 'di shod ces lung bstan pa la brten nas/ dang por bla chen 'brog la chos sgo skyel gyi tshul du byon/ de'i res a tsa ra dmar po'am/ la ba'i na bza' can du grags/ lan gnyis pa rje 'brog gis spyan drangs te/ de'i res klu 'dzin nam sprin 'dzin te/ ga ya dha ra zhes grags/ lan gsum pa la mgos lo tsā ba lhas btsas kyis spyan drangs te/ de'i res sprin gyi shugs can du grags/ lan bzhi pa gyi lo jo lo tsā ba zla ba'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs te/ de'i res kyang ga ya dha rar grags so/ /des na/ bla chen la chos sgo skyel du byon pa 'di kun mthun pas/ lo tsā ba la ma brten pa gcig dang / brten nas gsum ste bzhi byon pa rigs la khad yin/ 'on kyang / 'brog mis che ltad byas nas spyan drangs pa min pas/ gsum du byas kyang sgo skyel gyi don mi tshang ba ni min gsungs te ji ltar byon pa'i tshul lo/ /byon nas gsung ngag gi srol ji ltar btod snyam na/ spyir rje 'di nyid la bod du lo tsā ba'i slob ma bla chen/ mgos/ gyi jo/ gzhon nu shes rab/ mnyos 'byung po de lnga tsam byung ba las gsung ngag rin po che'i bka' drin nod cing yongs su rdzogs pa'i gsung ngag gi mdzod bzung nas spel ba'i mchog ni bla chen 'brog mi nyid yin la/

gyi jos kyang gsung ngag gi bka' drin thob nas/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang la 'gyur dang bshad pa sogs mdzad cing cung zad 'phel lo/ /mnyos la yang cha lag yongs su rdzogs pa ma byung yang / gsung ngag thob pa tsam ni yin 'dug gzhan gnyis la rgyud kyi skor las/ gsung ngag rin po che ni mi bzhugs gsungs te mdor na thog mar bla chen dang / bla chen gshegs mtshams su rtsams su gyi jo la gnang ba yin no// ༈ //gsum pa bla chen gyis spel tshul la gsum/ bla chen gyi sku che ba'i lo rgyus/ slob mchog ji ltar byung tshul/ de dag gis gsung ngag spel tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sngar bsnyad pa ltar/ phyi dar la stod smad gnyis nas dar tshul gnyis byung ba'i/ bla chen nyid kyi so thar gyi sdom rgyun ni/ smad dar nyid la brten pa yin te/ de yang / mnga' bdag dar ma'i sras 'od srung dang yum brtan gnyis las/ snga ma'i sras dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dang / skyid lhe nyi ma mgon gnyis/ phyi ma las stod kyi mgon gsum du grags pa ste/ stod nas bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ snga ma las/ dpal lde/ 'od lde/ lha lde ste smad kyi lde gsum du grags pa 'dis/ dpal ldan grom pa lha rtse'i pho brang na/ srid kyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i skabs nas/ bla chen dgongs gsal gyi mkhan bu/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug la pho nya mngags nas/ rgya shākya gzhon nu dang / se ye shes brtson 'grus dang / myang rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i dge slong bdun/ dge tshul gnyis dge bsnyen gcig ste bcu spyan drangs nas/ grom pa rgyang du dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ mnga' 'og nas byis pa shes brtson dang ldan pa rnams bsdus nas/ rgya yis mkhan po/ se yis slob dpon/ myang gis gsang ston mdzad de/ rab tu byung ba phyed dang sum brgya tsam gyi sgo nas/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad pa yin la/

de rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni bla chen nyid yin pas so/ /'o na bla chen nyid kyis/ spyir gsang sngags/ bye brag tu lam skor/ khyad par gsung ngag rnams ji ltar gsan cing spel snyam na/ spyir bla chen 'di nyid kyis/ 'phags yul du lan gnyis dang gsum byon zhes zha lugs pa 'dod cing / sa lugs la ni/ lan gcig byon pa'i yam me ba de tsam las med la/ gsum byon zer ba 'di la shes byed kyi khungs mi 'dug mod kyis/ gnyis byon zer ba 'di la khungs sgrig tu tsam yod gsungs/ gang ltar yang / bla chen nyid thog mar 'phags yul du 'byon pa'i rkyen ni/ khri dar mas bstan pa bsnubs tshabs ches pa nas bstan pa'i me ro yas mas nas cung zad sos mod kyang / zab mo'i gnad la rmongs shing / rang dga'i spyod 'gros dbang btsan pa kho na las bstan pa rnal ma'i sor chud par ma gyur pas/ mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa bka' bgrod te/ khyed 'di rnams nas 'phags pa'i yul du chos slob tu 'gro ba su yod cha rkyen gang dgos ma tshang ba med par sbyin no zhes gsungs pa na/ 'brog stag leng gsum gyis khas blangs/ de'i tshe mkhan slob rnams kyis/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin pas 'dul ba/ gzhi ma yin par phar phyin/ snying po yin pas dbu ma/ nying khu yin pas gsang sngags slobs shog cig ces pa bstan pa'i gnad dam srog 'dzin pa'i snying gtam gnad du gril ba gnang / mkhan po rgya yis/ leng ye shes gzhon nu la lkog tu gser srang bcu gla rtsi rgya ma sogs mdo tsam zhig gnang nas mang yul du sngon la blangs/ khong rang sku mtshams dam du bsdams nas slan chad su gang gis kyang phrin ma byed bsgo bar mdzad/ slob dpon se mkhyen pa yangs pas/ sbyin bdag rtsad po mched gsum 'khor bcas la rgyu mtshan zhib tu gleng nas ka ru ma mang du byung bas/ 'brog stag gnyis la gser srang lnga bcu gla rtsi rnga ma cha zangs bal sogs dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang /

yon tan dang bstun pa'i bsub bsnyen bskur bgyid do zhes sbyin bdag dang bcas pas chad bsgos mdzad/ de rnams kyi bar la bla chen gyis/ a tsa ra lha bu ba paṇḍi tar ming gdags su rung ba tsam gcig la big bar ti'i blo 'dzin sbyangs te 'phral skad byang po mkhyen/ de nas 'brog stag dpon slob bzhi/ a tsar ra gcig dang lngas ldom bu'i chas su zhugs nas byon/ bal yul mthil du/ bal po zhi ba bzang po la dbang lung sogs yan gar par nod/ lo gcig tsam chu snyoms shing bzhugs/ 'brog mi chen po ni lo tsā mkhas pa'i mchog tu gyur/ leng gis kyang 'phral skad legs par lobs nas stag los ni shes snying rgya skad du 'don pa tsam las cher ma mkhyen/ de nas bla ma bal po pa'i drung du bslab bya zhus nas rgya gar du 'gro bar brtsams pa na/ bal po'i zhal nas/ thog mar rdo rje gdan du song / byang chub chen po la gsol ba thob/ de nas bhi ka ma la shi la kho na deng dus bstan pa dar ba yin pas der song / sde de nyid na mkhas pa paṇḍi ta mkhas pa lnga brgya/ de'i nang nas mkhas pa sgo drug de rnams kyi mchog kyang / kho bo'i bla ma shanti pa nyid yin te/ khong sngon chad rgya gar nub phyogs pa yin pa la/ dus re zhig nas shri ka ma la shi lar bstan pa'i bya ba la song zhig par yi dam gyis lung bstan/ de'i tshe gnas de'i gnas brtan bgres po zhig gi mnal lam du/ sang nyin rgyal ba'i bstan pa shar phyogs la 'degs pas phyag dang bsnyen bkur gzobs shig bya ba byung nas/ skya rengs dang po la gaṇḍi'i sgras dge 'dun bsdus pa na/ rmi lam de ltar tshul mthun pa bcu tsam byung / nam langs pa na/ shanti pa dpon slob lnga bcu/ dpe cha'i mdzo khal/ yo byad gzhan gyi mdzo khal dang bcas te lam du zhugs/ dge 'dun sbyin bdag dang bcas pas bsnyen bkur gzabs bzhugs par gsol kyang ma gnang bar/ bri ka ma shī lar bzhud nas gdan phab ste/ shar sgo srung slad nas zhag 'ga' song ba na/

phyogs kyi dgra bcom pa so bdun rdzu 'phrul gyis lhags nas lung sde bzhi sogs/ chos mang du gsan/ snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs kun tu khyab par son pa de nyid yin pas/ de nyid la legs par gtugs/ gzhan lho sgo ba ngag dbang grags pa/ nub sgo ba shes 'byung blo gros/ byang sgo ba nā ro ta pa/ dbus kyi ka chen rin chen rdo rje dang / dzña na shri gnyis bzhugs pas/ de dag la'ang chos kyi 'brel tsam zhus shig ces bka' mchid mthil phyin par gnang / bla chen mched zla dang bcas pas kyang de ka bzhin bsgrubs/ rim kyis bri ka ma shī lar phebs/ de'i tshe bla chen gyis/ shanti pa la mkhan slob kyi bka' bzhin/ 'dul ba phar phyin dbu tshad sngags kyi rim pa sogs lhag ma ma lus pa nod/ khyad par sgo drug chos 'brel du grags pa/ shanti pa la mdo rgyud bsre ba/ ngag dbang grags pa la gnyug ma dran gsal/ shes 'byung blo gros la phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad sel ba/ nā ro ta pa la sdug bsngal gsum sel/ dzña na shri la 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi bar chad sel ba/ rin chen rdo rje la ting nge 'dzin sems kyi bar chad sel ba rnams nod de/ mdor na lo brgyad kyi bar la bslab sbyang sogs mthar phyin par mdzad/ de nas mi pham sbas pa'i bshes gnyen gyis po ta la nas spyan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i drung du byon/ sa sde gtsag nas gsol ba btab pas/ tho rangs su cha ba na zhal bstan/ 'di nas lam bar du bla ma zhig gis rjes su 'dzin/ bod du'ang chos sgo skyel byed pa gcig 'byung de mtshams chos nyan pa'i spros chod la/ 'chad pa nyams su len pa kho na gyis zhes pa'i lung bstan thob/ thugs spro bzhin pas tshur byon pa'i lam bar ku ba tshal bya ba'i nags su slebs/ nags gseb nas mkhar sil gyi sgra snyan thos/ de'i mod la/ dge slong chos gos gsum ldan 'khar sil thogs pas/ shing la 'khar sil bsnun pa na/ shing gi lha mos lus mi mngon bzhin du lag pa dkar 'jam rgyan gyis spras pas bsod snyoms phul/

shing los chab 'dren pa mthong bas/ thugs rje chen po'i lung bstan thog tu babs sam snyam/ thugs mchog tu spro nas zhabs la 'jus te rjes su gzung bar zhus pas de bzhin gnang ste/ ha te zhes bya ba tshong 'dus chen po dang ldan pa'i grong dang khad nye ba'i gnas su son/ gsang sngags kyi gdam pa 'dra zhu bar gsol bas/ nga'i gdams pa la nga rang gis dbang byed dgos gsungs/ dha te nas yo byad bsgrubs te/ dges pa rdo rje'i dbang nub gsum ma zhig gnang zhing gdams ngag kyang gnang ste/ bla ma chen po'i rgya gar la byon tshul gcig kho nar byed na/ 'di nyid kyi tshe lo bzhi bzhugs nas gdams pa nod tshul gleng la/ 'on kyang gnyis byon par 'chad na/ 'dir dbang gdam ngag de tsam zhig nod nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga la dgos 'dod mi ma yin mchog sman gyis sgrub pas/ yo byad kyis 'phongs pa min mod/ gsang sngags rten 'brel gyi che ba la/ yo byad dgos pas/ bod du song la gser la sogs pa'i dngos po sgrubs la lo gsum la 'khor ba gyis/ gdams ngag de dus ster/ bar chad mi 'byung bar lhas byin gyis brlabs 'dug pa gsungs/ de bzhin 'tshal/ de bar bla ma gar bzhugs/ mtshan dngos ji ltar lags zhus pas/ nga rgyal po tsa na kas yun ring po nas gsol ba btab pas/ lo bdun kho'i khab tu sdod/ de nas dpal gyi ri la 'gro gsang ba'i ming ni/ pradzña iṇḍa ru rtsi ta ste/ shes rab kyi dbang po gsal ba'am mdzes pa yin la/ da lta ni dpa' bo'i rdo rje/ gsum pa rje btsun sa skya pas shin tu dar tshul la gsum ste/ ring rgyud/ nye rgyud/ shin tu nye rgyud dar tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rje sa skya pa chen pos/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe/ rje zhang dgon pa ba'i drung du gsung ngag gsan nas lo bzhi song ba so gnyis pa'i steng du yongs su rdzogs nas bsgrubs pa'i lung sbyin pa yin te/ de yang dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshe/

bla ma ba ri ba bsten nas 'jam dpal bsgrubs pas thog mar mi g.yo ba zhal gzigs/ de nas da lta 'jam dpal brag phug tu grags par 'phags pa 'jam dpal gtso 'khor gsum pa zhig zhal bstan nas/ zhen pa bzhi bral la sogs pa'i chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa nod/ de nas rong ngur smrig tu brang ti dar ma snying po la mngon pa/ nyang stod du khyung rin po che grags la tshad ma/ gnam kha 'ur dar ba rgyal mtshan sku mched la gsang 'dus/ sgyi chur 'khon dgra lha 'bar ram shākya 'bar ram dkon mchog 'bar la kyai rdor/ na la rtser mal lo tsā ba la bde mchog gsan pa yin mod kyi/ skabs kyi gtso bo/ rje 'di nyid sgyi chur bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dbugs zhes bya ba'i mdog gi sa char bla ma se chos 'khor gyi gtso bor spyan drangs pa'i skabs gcig tu bla chen sogs sgyi chu ba'i grwa pa kha yar gyis bltar phyin pas/ bla ma se bshad rgyud mang po gsung zhing / grwa pa rnams la rim bzhin du/ dri rtog zhib par mdzad/ bla chen gyi thad du rlung ltas legs par brtags nas/ khyed gang pa yin gsungs/ 'khon gyi sras dod yin pa zhus pas/ khyed gzhon nu ma la rdzun che/ nga'i bla ma la sras mi mnga' gsungs/ brang rogs rdo rje 'od kyis sras yin tshul zhib par gleng pas/ mi gson gshin mi 'phrad zer te rdzun du 'dug gsungs nas/ zhal sprad cing shin tu dges par mdzad nas/ zhag 'ga' dbu sngas sbrel/ gsung ngag rin po che'i rtsa ba gsal byed 'phros don sogs kyi khog sgribs lam me ba gcig gnang / nga rgad po gog pa 'di la chos yod do myur du byon/ sang nga 'chi nyen yod do gsungs/ bla chen gyis/ sgyi chur byon nas/ de 'phral 'byon par brtsams pa na/ brang rogs rdo rje 'od na re/ bla ma 'di pa/ nged thams cad bas khyed kho na la rtsis che bar 'dug pas bla ma la zhus na 'thad zer/ phyag rten yang med/ rjes su mjal bas chog gsungs pas/ dar ljang kha gang bton nas phyag rten 'di la mdzod/

cis kyang mjal lo zer nas/ thugs 'thad po min pa gcig la drung du byon nas zhus pas/ se lce la re bya ba rdzun che nga'i bla ma mnga' ris pa'i chos kyi dral drul 'dra sgrugs nas 'chad pa yin/ de la yon tan ci yang med/ rgyud gnyan po'i 'phro ma gcod gsungs nas ma gnang / 'o na sa skyar chas 'dra sgrub tu 'gro bar zhu zhus pas/ mnyes po rang min pa gcig la gnang nas sa skyar byon te/ de lta bu 'phral bla ma phan tshun gyi phrag dog lta bur snang bas/ bla ma se myur du sku 'da' bas lam yongs rdzogs mi 'byung zhing / bla ma zhang la yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas phan 'dogs dpag med 'ong ba'i phyis 'byung gi rten 'brel khyad par can gzigs pa yin gsungs/ de nas nye bar bla ma sgyi chu ba sku 'das/ zhal chems bzhin rab tu byung bar dgongs pa/ bla ma gnam kha'u ba'i gsung gis/ phyis 'byung gi rten 'brel gcig yod pas/ rab byung ma byas pa phan che/ khong gshin po las nga gson po ngag btsan/ nga'i dam tshig las 'das na chos skyong gi cho 'phrul 'ong zhes zhi drag gi ngos nas bzlogs te/ sras brgyud kyi chos rgyud dri ma med pa dar rgyas su byed pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can gzigs pa yin gsungs/ de nas skabs gcig tu/ bla ma zhang la gsung ngag zhu bar bzhed nas/ bla ma gnam la zhus pas/ sgom chen pa 'di tsho rdzun che/ chos la dum bu mang po byas nas/ lhag yod ri'i mna' skyel ba skad byed/ sgom nus na gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs bstan pa'i nod rdzas sgoms gsungs pa la/ bdag rang la yid ches gcig bdog zhus pas/ 'o na song gsungs nas gnang / de nas jo sras rgyal po dang gnyis kyis/ khrab stong ri ba gcig bsnams nas dings su phebs/ rgan mo gcig la/ bla ma zhang gang yin dris pas/ pha gi yin zer nas/ thags ma 'dra'i gseb na/ gtam chal chol 'dra gsungs ral cog gyon zhing / sham thabs med par shang 'gag bsnams pa gcig 'dug

ko mog gcig tu spyan drangs nas phyag phul bas/ khyed ni gsar ma gcig 'dra na/ rtog pa'ang che ba yin/ khyed nor gsungs/ khrab phul bas/ da cir bzlas/ nga rang yang bun len pa gcig yin gsungs/ de ma lags bdag gsung ngag rin po che zhu 'dod pa lags gsungs pas/ de 'dra'i ming tsam yang da lan min pa thos ma myong / nga rdzogs chen tsa mun dang / bram ze'i skor la mkhas pa gcig yin/ skom sing dang / gnas khang yang med do/ nyi ma snga ba la bzhud gsungs nas ma gnang ba la/ yod do bla ma se gsung ba la/ bla ma rdzun gsung bar 'dug snyam nas pha tshad du byon pas/ 'od mchog gi pha zhang skyabs ses/ da ci'i de ni/ bla ma se dges pa'i jo sras sa skya pa de 'dra na zhus pas/ 'o na dam tshig gi nyes par 'gyur nyen yod pas zlog gsungs nas/ thugs dgyes par mjal te gsung gleng zhib par mdzad/ da lan 'dir nya ma rnams la chos gcig kyang bshad dgos yod cing bsam mno 'dra yang btang dgos pa yod/ se ston rdor dbyung gis paṇa chen dang paṇa chung mang po spyan drangs nas chos 'khor byed pa'i skabs su/ rnal 'byor pa'i bshad nyan skud pa 'gugs pa 'dra ba 'di mi mdzes/ ston byon cig tshang bar bgyid do gsungs nas dus btab/ ston de bzhin du byon nas/ gsung ngag rin po che rgyud gsum lam skor cha lag dang bcas pa lo bzhi la tshang bar gsan pa yin la/ khrid kyi skabs su/ bla ma'i ljags cung zad skrang ba la/ nga tsho'i bar na dam tshig gi sel cung zad 'dug pas/ yi ge brgya ba zlos gsungs nas de bzhin mdzad pas sangs/ sgrub pa'i lung sbyin nas/ sku'i bkod pa bya dang ri dwags su sprul ba dang / skyil krung gis dings kyi gzhung khebs pa sogs bstan nas/ nged spun gyis kyang / lo bco brgyad kyi bar du bla ma'i drung du bsdad kyang / lan gsum sgro 'dogs gcod du 'gro dgos pa byung / yi ges shes pa'i chos min pas/ sgom la 'bungs/

bsgoms nyams kyis spros pa nang nas chod na/ tshig gi mdud pa phyi nas mi 'gro kha med yin/ lo bco brgyad kyi bar du yod pa'i ming tsam yang ma zer/ de nas 'chad dam yi ger 'bri khyod rang chos kyi bdag po yin no/ /zhes sogs lung bstan dpag med mdzad de/ ring rgyud las dar tshul lo/ /gnyis pa nye rgyud ni rje sa chen dgung lo zhe bzhi bzhes dus zer yang / zhe bdun gyi steng du gsan pa dag gsung ste/ de yang gung thang du dug byung ba'i dug ro langs nas/ zla gcig tsam gyi bar du bsnyel bas sngar gyi chos thams cad bsnyel/ grogs la dri sa ni med/ rgya gar du phyin yang ji ltar yod cha med snyams/ thugs cung zad ma bde nas/ 'jam dpal brag phug tu sku mtshams bsdams/ bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ ji zhig nas rje dgon pa pa mnal lam du byon nas chos gsungs/ thugs cung zad spro nas gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ rje dgon pa pa dngos su byon nas chos gsungs pas/ chos thams cad thugs la gsal le dran/ de nas kyang thugs ches spro zhing gsol ba ches cher btab pas/ tho rangs kha rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa zhabs skyil krung phyag chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas su shar phyogs nag po pa zhabs skyil krung / g.yas ba men gyi rwa dang / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon du ga ya dha ra na bza' dkar po lding gon mdzad nas rdo dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ rgyab tu ko ṭa ling pa pus mo btsugs nas gdugs 'dzin pa/ mdun du bi na sa ste nags khrod pa/ thal mo sbyar nas bdud rtsi 'bul ba ste/ gtso 'khor lnga sa dkar po rgyab yol du mdzad/ ya gi mon brog nas/ ma gi 'bal brog gi bar skyil krung gis khyab par mdzad nas/ 'di rnams thams cad nga dbang gsung zhing byon nas zhal bstan pas thugs la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs/ a la la ste zhes sogs pa'i bstod pa mdzad/

de nas zla ba gcig gi bar du 'tsho ba zur nas blangs shing / sku mtshams bsdams nas/ gtso 'khor ci rigs par byon zhing / bla med kyi rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis sam/ bla med dang 'brel ba'i dbang byin rlabs sogs kyi chos sna bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ khyad par du lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhi la sogs pa gsan pa yin te/ 'di dag gi tshul ni/ rje btsun gyis sga kyog la bsdams pa nang cung zad yod cing / gsal bar ni zhu byas kyi yi ge na yod pa bzhin gsungs la/ 'dir gnad kyi gtso bo ni/ rje btsun sku mched kyis brda tshig gi don bkrol nas gsungs te/ de yang ye shes zla ba dri med mig la shar/ /sde snod gsum gyi yon tan gsal bar byas/ /rgya mtsho'i gting du nor bu bzhin du mdzes/ /blo dang ldan pas rtogs 'gyur gzhan gyis min/ /zhes pa 'di/ rje sa'i tshigs bcad gcig dang 'brel nas glegs bam dkar chag gi dpe la la'i mjug tu bris yod pas/ rje pa'i gsung yin no snyam du 'khrul pa'ang yod mod kyi/ dngos la slob dpon rin po che'i gsung yin la/ de'i don bkrol nas/ zla bas ni gcig gi grangs mtshon pas/ ye shes lnga ldan gyi gcig rdo rje 'chang chen te/ rgyud pa kun gyi thug sa dang po'o/ /mig gis gnyis kyi grangs 'dzin pas rgyud pa gnyis pa birwa pa ste/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyi 'od dkar dri ma med pa der shar ba'o/ /sde snod ni gsum gyi grangs 'dzin pas brgyud pa gsum pa bla chen sa skya pa chen po ste/ de nyid kyi yon tan gyi nor bu gsal bar mdzad pa'o/ /rgya mtsho ni bzhi'i grangs 'dzin pas rgyud pa bzhi pa slob dpon rin po che ste/ de nyid kyi thugs mtshor chud pas/ rgya mtsho'i nor bu lta bur shin tu mdzes shing dgos 'dod stsol ba'o/ /tshul 'di lta bu'i nye rgyud kyi don/ blo dang skal ba dman pas mi rtogs pas/

skyes dang sbyangs pa'i rnam dpyod dang skal ba mchog dang ldan pas/ khongs su chud nas rtsol ba rab kyis blangs shing bshad sgrub kyi rgyal mtshan gyi tog tu gzung bar bya ba ste/ brda 'grol dang po'o/ /brda tshig gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun rin po che la/ ram lding ma ba 'byung gnas rdo rjes/ khyed la brgyud pa mchog gcig yod 'dug pa/ brgyud pa khyad par can dang / brgyud pa de nyid la yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' tshul gcig cis kyang gnang dgos zhus pas/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa/ /rig byed kyis gsal lag pas me la bsgo/ /de 'od kun gsal chu gter 'byung bar babs/ /blo ldan don 'di shes na smra bar gyis/ /zhes lan du gsungs pa yin la/ phyis stong thun sa bcad du 'jug par mdzad pa 'di nyid yin no/ /'di'i brda 'grel mdzad pa po ni ma byung ste/ bdag chen rin po che skyes lhas kyi 'phags pa brag phug tu thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i skabs gcig tu/ chos rje kun mkhyen gyis mjal du byon/ sku mtshams dam yang / thugs dges pas mjal/ zab mo'i don la 'bel gtam kho na mdzad pa'i mu der/ khyed kyis ram lding ma ba la gnang ba'i brda tshig 'di'i don rtogs sam 'di gnad du che ba yin gsungs pas/ bdag gis zhig pa ma chud gsungs nas/ dpal ldan sa skya'i bar la/ a bla med phyogs ni zhes yang yang gsungs/ sa skyar phebs ma thag nā ro paṇḍe bshes gnyen grags kyis bzhengs pa'i rje pa'i sku 'dra'i drung du gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ thugs la brda don gsal dran nas/ brda 'grel nges pa'i dpal ster zhes pa mdzad/ de bzhin du chos rje rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / srad pa kun blo sogs kyi yang brda 'grel re'ang 'byung mod/ rang re'i brgyud pa 'di'i lugs/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung bzhin 'di ltar mdzad de bla med ni/ bla med kyi rgyud dam bla med dang 'brel ba'i chos sna/

phyogs ni bcu'i grangs 'dzin te bcu/ ri ni bdun te/ des bsgyur bas bdun bcu/ mig ni gnyis te/ bdun bcu rtsa gnyis/ rig byed ni bzhi yin la/ 'di bla med kyi rgyud dang man ngag gnyis char la nye rgyud ston byed yin pas/ rgyud ni 'chad thabs bzhi dang / man ngag ni snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgo nas gsal bar mdzad pa ste/ lag pa gnyis pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ me gsum pa bla chen sa skya pa la bsgos pa'o/ /de'i phrin las kyi 'od phyogs thams cad du gsal bar mdzad nas/ chu gter bzhi pa slob dpon rin po che la babs shing / 'byung ba lnga pa rje btsun rin po che nyid la babs so/ /des ni brda tshig gnyis pa'i don bkrol ba ste/ nye rgyud dus nam gyi tshe dang / tshul ji ltar du byung ba bstan pa'o/ /de lta bu'i bla chen nyid/ sras rje btsun sku mched/ dbon chos rje pa khu dbon 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched de bdun po 'di ni/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud rin po che la 'jam dbyangs bdun rgyud ces yongs su grags pa de nyid yin pas/ de dag gi yon tan gyi khyad par ni ji lta bu zhes tshol ba'i ngal ba ni/ blo dang ldan pa dag la don med pa yin mod/ 'on kyang gdul bya'i snang ngo dang bstun nas ngo mtshar ba'i cha shas ji ltar 'tshams par bstan tshul cung zad tsam gnyis/ thad so thad so'i bgo skal du gsungs te/ de yang bla chen nyid kyis gling 'di nyid du sku'i bkod pa drug bstan nas/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang / 'jam dbyangs dang birwa pa las mdo rgyud kyi zab mo'i gnad thams cad thugs su chud nas/ 'chad cing 'doms pa dang skabs gcig tu khams pa gcig gis/ khyed spyan ras gzigs yin pa'i rtags mngon sum du mi ston na/ kho bo 'di nyid du 'gum mo zhes gri snying khar btsugs pas/ de btsugs mi dgos 'di la ltos gsungs nas/ phyag mthil nas spyan bstan pa sogs dang /

sku 'da' tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ spur khang nas 'khor lo bde mchog phyogs gang nas bltas kyang zhal bzhi par 'ongs pa gcig tu phal mo ches mthong zhing / dge bshes bzang ri phug pas bskor ba mdzad pas rtsa zhal khong la khyu ru bsgyur ba dang 'ga' zhig gis ni kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad par yang mthong zhing / spur thal mtsho la sbyangs pas/ mtsho la bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lam me byung nas/ deng sang sku 'bum rnam rgyal du grags pa'i thog la mtshon byed du bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor bris nas yod pa 'di yin/ phyis ni spur zhu ba'i dud ris las grub pa yin zhes gleng bar 'dug gsungs/ de nas bde ba can/ po ta la/ u rgyan/ gser mdog can bzhir sku'i bkod pa bzhi bstan nas gshegs te/ de'i rgyu mtshan rim pa ltar/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi longs bde ba can sku sprul po ta la yod pa dang / ayon rgyud sde'i glegs bam mkha' 'gro mas rgyas btab nas yod pa dang / sras rje btsun 'byon pas de'i zhing sbyong ba'i ched yin zhes zhu byas dngos grub kyis bshad gsungs/ 'o na de lta bu'i bla chen sa skya pas gsung ngag ji ltar spel snyam na/ lnga bcu'i stod kho nar zhang gis gdams pa'i bka' rgya grol bas/ dgung lo lnga bcu skor du slebs pa'i dus de tsam du mdo smad kyi khams pa a seng zhes grags pa/ skyu ra a skyabs bya ba bla ma zhang la khams 'dus pa dang po tsam gyi khrid tshar ba/ bla chen dang phar slob tshur slob tu 'brel ba de'i dbon nam sras su byed pa des/ lam 'bras khungs chod nas zhus pa'i ngor/ gsung ngag gi bka' rgya bkrol ba dang / rten 'brel 'grigs pa nas/ gsung ngag rin po che gnang ba'i thog ma de yin/ gzhung bshad la snga ba yang des zhus pa'i a seng ma ste/ lam 'bras yi ger bkod pa'i yang thog mar grags pa'o/ /de nas lo bzhi ma gsungs/ de nas gcig dang gsum dang lnga dang bdun la sogs pa dang /

sum cu rtsa bdun dang / mthar nges med gsungs shing / gzhung bshad kyi skabs su/ dang por thog mtha' gnyis dang / bar du gnyis de tshogs 'khor bzhi mdzad/ de nas thog mtha' dang / bar dam tshig gso ba ste gsum du mdzad/ de nas gnyis dang gcig la sogs ci rigs par mdzad de/ mdor na gsung ngag rin po che'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad pa yin no/ /'o na rje bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i gsung las byon pa'i gzhung bshad sogs ngo mtshar ba'i yi ge'i tshogs ji 'dra yod/ de dag bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas 'dzin pa'i bu slob kyi tshogs ngo mtshar ba ji 'dra ba byung snyam na/ bla chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad dam rnam 'grel ni bcu gcig yod do zhes grags mod/ bcu gcig po'i ngos 'dzin rjes 'jug gzhan thams cad la rang gi pho tshod kyis gzhal ba tsam ma gtogs/ yid ches kyi khungs gsal bar byon pa su yang med la/ brgyud pa 'di pa'i lugs kyi ni/ bdag chen rin po ches/ zhu byas dngos grub kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa zhig nas 'di'i khungs gsal bar rnyed nas/ yid ches pa'i gtan tshigs dang ldan pa zhig yod do zhes gsungs te/ de yang / de lta bu'i bstod pa'i dpe de nyid/ yar lungs pa'i bla brgyud dang / sa chen gyi dus yar bsgom se bo/ rje btsun gyi dus/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ chos rje pa'i dus/ do pa ston gsal/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ chos rje bla ma dam pa'i dus yar lungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rin po che'i dus/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog ste/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim pa dang / yar lungs pa'i gdung brgyud rim par dpon slob tu 'brel chags byon pa de dag las brgyud de/ seng rgyal gyi dbon po mkhan chen bsod rgyal ba nas/ bdag chen rin po che'i phyag tu byon pa yin la/ de nyid las zab don yongs su rdzogs pa'i slob ma ni/ pho brgyad mo gsum dag la yi ger bsdams/

/zhes bshad nas/ de'i mchan snying du so so'i ngo 'dzin 'byung ba/ bdag chen nyid kyis sdom du mdzad pa ni/ a seng zhu klog yum dang sras/ /zla zangs man ngag sgam 'bu mnyag /ces gsungs pa ltar/ a seng la gdams pa'i a seng ma/ zhu byas rang la gdams pa'i zhu byas ma/ klog skya jo sras chos grags la gdams pa'i klog ma/ sa chen gyis/ thog mar bod btsad po'i sras rgyud ma gcig yum du zhes pa las/ sras rtsad tsha kun dga' 'bar sku gshegs pa nas/ yum thugs chos la 'gyur nas bla chen las bde kyai'i zab don blangs/ bskyed rim bde mchog dang / rdzogs rim gsung ngag la mdzad pa gcig byung ba de nyid la gdams pa/ bskyed rim bde mchog la sbyar ba'i rnam 'grel yum don ma/ sras rje btsun sku mched gnyis kyi don du shog ril du bkol ba/ thugs sras gnyan phul byung ba gtsug tor rgyal por grags pa/ mtshan dngos bsod nams rdo rjes khrigs su bsgrigs te/ sras gsum la gdams pa sras don ma/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan du grags pa bla chen las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs nas sras la phog pa de nyid la gdams pa zla rgyal ma/ zangs ri phug pa la gdams pa ri phug ma/ mang mkhar gyi jo mo mang chung ma la gdams pa mang chung ma/ zhabs cung zad skyog cing gyol ba mkhas pa sga theng la gdams pa sga theng ma/ g.ya' lung gi jo mo 'a 'u ma la gdams pa ma 'u ma/ mnyam zhig ra ba dbang phyug rgyal mtshan la gdams pa rnam 'grel mnyag ma ste/ gzhan dag gis nā ro baṇḍe ma dang / stod ston byang chub shes rab ma gang 'thad bcug nas mang chung ma dor bas ni/ pho brgyad mo gsum gyi don ma tshang bas/ rnam 'grel bcu gcig ni 'di kho nar gsal bas/ gzhan du yid g.yo bar mi bya'o/ /phyis chos rje kun mkhyen la/ bdag chen rin po ches/ dpe 'dis gsal btab pa na/ chos rje yang shin tu thugs tshims/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa la/

gang nas kyang ngo mtshar ba'i cha shas re ka 'dug gsungs nas sngar rje rdo rje 'chang gis ngos 'dzin ltar mdzad pa la/ phyis rgyud pa 'di pa ba ltar mdzad pa gcig byung zhing / chos rje pad rgyal ba la yang de bzhin du mdzad pas/ phyis 'di bzhin du mdzad gsungs/ mdzad pa'i go rim ni thog mar a seng ma/ de nas skabs gcig tu sga theng gis ru mtshams su bla chen chos 'khor la spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ khong gis zin bris 'dra gzigs pas/ gnad 'chugs pa 'ga' re 'dug nas da nga shi na chos 'di nub 'gro ba 'dug gsungs nas/ khong gis yang zhus pa'i ngor rnam 'grel sge theng ma mdzad la/ mjug tu rnam 'grel mnyag ma mdzad cing / gzhan rnams kyi go rim ma mthong gsungs/ de ltar rnam 'grel bcu gcig las/ deng sang gi bar du bshad bka'i rgyun ma chad pa ni/ mnyag ma nyid yin la/ lung rgyun yod pa ni/ thog mtha' gnyis dang sras don ma nyid de gsum mo/ /mang mkhar lam 'bras pa blo bzang dkar mo la/ rnam 'grel bcu gcig gi lung bzhugs zhes gleng yang / rje btsun la gnang ba'i rdo rje tshig rkang ma dang / rgyal ba 'byung gnas la gnang ba'i dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod ces sogs/ rnam 'grel med pa dang ma yin pa la grangs su btab pa'i nor ba du ma mthong bas yid brtan du rung ba tsam med gsungs/ de bzhin du don ri grags chen la gzhung bshad bco brgyad kyi lung bzhugs zhes gleng ba dang / sgon mo lhas pa mkhan chen byang chub dpal la lam 'bras kyi bka' srol bco brgyad bzhugs zhes gleng ba yang / rgyang nas sgra snyan che ba tsam ni 'dug nye bar slan na deng 'dra ba las med dam gsungs/ gzhung bshad dam rnam 'grel bcu gcig pa de tsam du nges sam snyam na/ bla chen nyid kyis slob bu la dngos su gdams pa ni de tsam du grags la/ bla chen thugs sras dang bcas pa'i gzhung bshad gcig tu bsdoms nas/ brgyud pa 'di pa ba rang nyid kyis 'dren pa ni nyi shu tsam yod gsungs te/

bcu gcig gi khar/ na ro paṇḍes mdzad pa/ ston sgom byang chub shes rab kyis mdzad pa/ me mnyam pradzñā dzwa las mdzad pa/ zhu brag dmar bas mdzad pa/ zhang ze ma bas mdzad pa/ 'u yug gi dbyar sbu ba mas mdzad pa/ phag mo grub pas mdzad pa la sogs pa'o/ /a seng ma chen mor grags pa 'di the ba'i dbang du byas na nyi shu rtsa gcig yin gsungs so/ /slob ma'i tshogs ji lta bu snyam na/ bla chen gyi mtshan lam dang / bla ma zhang dgon pa ba sogs kyis lung bstan dang bstun nas/ grub thob gsum/ bzod thob bdun/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa brgyad cu/ zhes grangs su 'cha' yang / grub thob dang bzod thob sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pas/ 'di dag kho na'o zhes pa ni mi gsung la/ dang po gsum ni/ sing ga gling gi rnal 'byor pa/ byang sems stag sgom pa skyi 'bar ro/ /dang po ni/ sing ga'i gling nas 'ongs pa'i/ a tsa ra gcig gis/ na la rtser bla chen la sman bzang drug 'ga' dang / zab rgyan gyi bla re gcig phul nas mjal/ lam sbas bshad kyi khrid kyis bkris nas zla ba drug nas grub pa thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ yul rtag sde seng ge lung pa/ sku lus bzhag bdun dor/ mthar de nyid la bzhugs te grub pa thob pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yul phrang 'og pa ste/ hūm̐ rings 'byongs pa'i rtags skad rab dung 'dra ba/ khrid 'phro mnyan phul byung pa la bskyangs te grub pa thob pa'o/ /bzod thob bdun ni/ rje btsun rin po che/ zhu byas/ sga ston rdo rje grags/ bsgrom pa 'od zer grags/ nags sgom pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'tshar kha'i rnal 'byor pa/ mang chung ma'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ yul lho pa/ zhu ston rog po bya ba'i dbon po yin/ khong bla chen la dad nas sa skyar 'gro bar zhus pas/ nga rgad po gcig btsun chung 'di rnams la kha ta dang chos 'chad pa 'di khyod kho na'i ched yin/ khyod gang la 'gro gsungs pas/ 'o na rang re'i phar phyin na/ bdud la la slob dpon gyi cha byad du 'ong bar bshad pa de khyed du mi gda'am zhus pas/

lan ma byung ste/ gnang ba thob/ sa skyar byon/ bla chen la gsung ngag thob/ res gcig gzhung bshad kyi/ bla ma dang grogs kyi dbang gis thabs phyogs su lhung ba zhes sogs kyi bshad pa gnang ba'i skabs su/ zhu byas kyis cung zad de bzhad nas sngar gyi lo rgyus zhus pas/ bla chen gyi zhal nas/ 'o na cung thal brtag pa gcig smras pa 'dug pa gsungs/ de lta bu'i bzhu byas te/ bod so mi sod gsungs nas/ rgya gar la bzhud/ bla chen sa dkar la sogs kyi dan na chos gsung ba'i skabs gcig tu/ bya rgod gcig 'phur byung / de nas zhu byas 'dra ba gcig chos mnyan la 'dug mi rnams the tshom log ge ba'i mu nas/ slar yang bya rgod du byas nas 'phur song ngo / /yang rje btsun sku mched dgong mo tshogs 'khor gcig mdzad pa'i dus/ a po zhu byas de yang yod na ang gsung ba sogs gleng 'phros byung bas/ a po zhu byas 'ol ma si'i phreng ba rlon pa dang / 'bras rlon gyi snyi ma tshar re ba gcig phyag rten mdzad/ da ci nyi zer la 'ong gsungs nas slebs byung / rje pas a po zhu byas/ do nub mi yang nyung rdzu 'phrul gcig ston dang gsungs pas/ de 'dra mi gsung ba zhu zer/ tsab tsob byed/ mi sto yis cis kyang ston cig gsungs pas/ thog mar rmig rtse gcig nas/ zhu yas 'dra ba ston pas/ phyag gsum btsal gral la 'khod/ de nas de 'dra ba bdun byung nas/ slar rim par bsdus te/ de tsam du gda' 'o gsungs te/ rdzu 'phrul de 'dra ba mang po bstan pa'o/ /sga ston ni/ khams pa ste rje pas sgo ston gdams yig gnang ba de yin/ sgom pa 'od grags ni/ dmyal ba'i gnas sbyong shar ba de yin te/ de yang sa skya'i mdun yin no snyam pa gcig na/ shing sdong gcig gi rtse na 'dug mar bltas pas/ mtsho dmar lhog ge ba gcig 'dug der ma lhung na dga' ste snyam tsam na/ lhung song bas/ rus par khrol te song / 'khyags na dga' ste snyam tsa na 'khyags/

de lus sbyar ba lkog pas/ glo snying khrol mthong tsa na sad pa la sogs pa'o/ /nags sgom pa ni yul rta nag pa yin/ chung ngu nas/ gshin rje gshed la thugs dam byed pa gcig gi phyugs 'tsho mkhan byas/ khong gi thugs dam gyi la sod byas pas/ ba glang gshin rje dang / sgra thams cad sngags su shar/ khong la zhus pas/ las 'phro yod pa yin gsungs nas/ sre ba'i cho ga mdzad pa sogs so/ /'tshar kha'i rnal 'byor pa ni/ bla chen gyis/ sku'i bkod pa gcig gis/ 'tshar khar gsung ngag gsungs nas/ 'bras bu thob pa'i rtags dang ldan pa de'o/ /mang chung ma ni dud 'gro'i gnas sbyong shar te/ mang khar gyi mdar/ ko ko yog tu skyes/ g.yag khyu chen po gcig byung ste/ rmig le la bcar ba snyam byed pa na/ sad pa sogs byung ba de'o/ /gsum pa shin tu nye rgyud dar tshul ni/ bla chen sa skya pa zhi bar gshegs nas lo zhe bzhi/ rje btsun rin po che nga drug bzhes pa'i tshe/ snyam mo ru mtshams kyi gtsang khang dgon par/ mnal lam du bla chen byon nas/ rdo dkar 'jam la padma 'dab ma brgyad pa phyogs bzhi stong pa/ mtshams bzhir ya ra la was mtshan pa'i brda dang / don tshigs bcad du bsdus pa ni/ dang po kun gzhi gdan du bya/ /gnyis pa rlung la sbar 'dzin bya/ /byang chub chu rgyun dbu mar gzhug /sa sogs 'byung ba dbang du bsdu/ /zhes nyams len dril nas brten pa'o/ /de lta bu'i rje btsun rin po che de'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa cung zad ni/ rgya gar du 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim gsal zhing / rdzogs rim dang lhag bsam dang bral ba zhig tshe'i dus byas nas/ dbu dgu'i dod wa ba dgu brtsegs byas pa'i 'dre gdug pa can gcig tu skyes/ de nyid kha che paṇa chen bod du 'byon pa'i rjes su 'brangs/ su gang gis kyang zlog par ma nus pa'i tshe/ paṇa chen sa skyar phebs pa'i skabs su rje pas rdo dril bsnams nas bsu ba la byon/ gab 'brangs de mkhyen nas/

rdor dril nam mkhar bzhag ste bskrad pas/ rgya gar la yang zlog ma nus par rgya nag la song bas/ deng sang rgya nag gi nor kham che tsam gyi rjes su myul ba de'o/ /yang skabs shig tu rje btsun gzims spyil dkar por thugs dam la bzhugs dus chos rje pa la/ paṇa chen gyis/ khyod kyi khu bo ci byed kyin yod gsungs/ thugs dam la bzhugs zhus pas/ rang re ltar 'gro gsungs/ bdag gis sngon la phyin lags kyi zhus pas/ mnyam du 'gro gsung nas/ rje pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i bdag bskyed tshar nas mdun bskyed kyi mchod bstod mdzad pa'i thad du phebs/ rje pas phyag mdzad snyam bzhengs nas rdo dril cog rtse'i khar bzhag par dgongs tsa na/ bar snang la khrol le bzhag 'dug paṇa chen pa na re/ de tsam la ngo mtshar rgyu tsam cang yod dam gsungs pas/ ngo mtshar du re nas byas pa ma lags gsungs/ rje pa la paṇa chen pas phyag lan mdzad pas/ paṇa chung rnams kyis/ khong dge bsnyen gcig la phyag lan mdzad par mi 'os zhes sngar gong nas phyag lan mi mdzad par zhu phul bar gda'/ chad yod pa ma lags sam zhus pas/ de yin te kho ma hā badzra dngos su 'dug pa gsungs te/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du gzigs pa yin gsungs/ yang skabs gcig tu sa skyar paṇa chen pas/ dus 'di la nyi ma gzas 'dzin zhes yi ge btab/ rje pas de skad mi gsung bar zhu/ de res cis kyang mi 'dzin pa 'dug zhus pas/ paṇa chung rnams kyis thugs khrel gyi rnam pa mdzad/ nyi ma gza' 'dzin dus btab bzhin ma byung bas/ paṇa chen pa na re/ de tsam dag kho rang shes te/ stod ya gi na dge bsnyen rgad po gcig nga rgyal yod gsungs lo/ /yang rje pas/ klu nag po 'khun shes la/ nga gtsug lag khang gcig byed pas/ khyod kyi nor 'di rnams gzhan cig tu bskyal dgos gsungs pas/ phyogs kun tu btsal bas/ rgya mtsho'i mtha' pha gi na cung zad cig 'dug gzhan skyel sa ma rnyed zer/ ci tsam nas 'khyogs gsungs pas/

gser rkyang pa bskyal na yang lo stong dgos zer/ 'o na khyod rang sdod las sa blang gsungs nas/ mon rdo rje ra dzas sna drangs/ rje pas ded de/ deng sang bla brang shar gyi 'phong rom me ba de yin/ de nas dbu rtse rnying mar grags pa 'di bzhengs pa yin no/ /yang rje pa byang gi sa cha/ brang phug lho sbrel ba/ bar na dkar khung yod pa gcig na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba rgyang ba na/ lung pa'i mda' na jig dir mang po 'dug nye gnas kyis bltas pas/ rta pa mang po byung / ji zhig nas rje pa'i gzim phug tu song / shong sa ni med snyam dkar khung nas bltas pas/ mi mang po skad mi go ba sna tshogs smra zhing thal mo sbyar byis pa lo brgyad pa gos dkar gyon zhing / g.yu'i bya ru btsugs pa gcig gis lo tsā byed/ rje pa 'gro ba'i don la 'byon dgos tshul zhu ba na/ nga rgas shing las 'brel tsam med pas khyed la phan mi thogs/ nga'i tsha bo kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang khyed las 'brel yod pas gtong ngo gsung ba sogs gleng / de nas rje pa byon nas chang yod dam gsungs/ mang po tsam med bum gang bdog zhus pas/ ci rung gis bltar mi rung bas/ khyod rang ma lta zhig gsungs/ chang thod par byin rlabs mdzad pa dang / thams cad bzi bzi 'thung zhing / mtshan gang glu gar byed pa mthong ste/ hor gyi lha gnam thel dang / bod kyi btsan thang rgyal po yin gsungs/ gnang klu gtsug na rin chen rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa mgo sa skya mjug rgya nag tu bsdad pa'i sgo nas/ dpal ldan sa skya pa la dpal 'byor gyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa sogs gsungs te/ mdor bsdus tsam yin la/ zhib tu chos rje pas mdzad pa'i rnam thar mnal lam ma la sogs bzhin yin no/ /de lta bu'i rje btsun rin po ches gsung ngag rin po che'i bstan pa bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas legs par bzung bas/ slob ma'i mchog bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig byon pa las/ phrin las kyi rgyun 'dzin pa'i gtso bo ni chos rje pa nyid yin la/

rje pa nyid kyis/ lam 'bras glegs bam du bsgrigs pa sogs 'og tu smra zhing / lhor dkar shākya grags/ nub tu nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ byang du gsal la ba dbang phyug grags/ shar du paṇḍe gshin rje grags te/ grags pa'i mtha' can bzhi zhes grags pa'i/ dkar shākya grags kyis/ gzhung bshad dang / dbang chu sogs mdzad/ grwa ston blo gros grags pas kyang / gzhung bshad mdzad de/ tshig sna ring zhing phun sum tshogs pa gcig yod/ mdzad byang med pas min no zhes gleng ba'ang yod mod/ brgyud pa 'di pa ba dag des mdzad par ngos 'dzin gsungs/ yang dbyil ston rgyal ba bzang po/ gyis kyang / rje pa la lam 'bras tshar bco brgyad gsan cing / de dag gis bar la lam 'bras kyi yi ge sna gcig kyang ma gzigs sam/ phyis rje pa la dri gtug yang dag mdzad nas khong rang gis gzhung bshad cig mdzad de/ 'di la yang gnad zab po yod gsungs/ rje pa'i bla ma'i gtso bo ni slob dpon rin po che ste/ sku lus ma spangs par gshegs so zhes kyang 'dod la/ rje pa'i bla ma mnyan phul byung ba ni/ sa skya'i dan snying nas/ rin po che'i khri dang bcas te/ sku lus ma spangs par gshegs pa kun gyis mthong zhes/ lam zab kyi yi ge las 'byung gsungs so/ /chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos gsung ngag rin po che'i rgyun spel ba'i slob ma ni/ bshad pa'i rgyud 'dzin lho dmar rnam gnyis/ man ngag dang sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin tshogs grub dbon gsum/ zhes grags pa'i/ dmar chos rgyal gyis/ chos rje'i gsung la zin bris byas pa gzhung bshad dmar ma dang / chos 'byung zhib mo rdo rje dang / gegs sel bka' rgya ma/ lam bsdus 'dod pa'i lcags kyu/ bla ma rin 'byung sogs yig chung dang bcas pa mdzad de/ de'i slob ma gye re sgang ston nam snar thang sgang ston te/ sgang ston sher 'bum/ des dkar po brang pa rin chen seng ge zhes grags pa lo brgya dang lnga lon pa des/

dpal ldan tshul khrims nas brgyud de brgyud pa 'di la zam ma chad par bzhugs pa'o/ /lho pa kun mkhyen rin chen dpal bzang pos/ gzhung bshad lnga tsam mdzad/ mdzad byang med par bsdus tsam gcig dang / phyis rtsom rgyas pa mdzad byang can gnyis yod cing / sku shin tu bgres pa nas/ byang ngos su chos rje nyid la brda don gsal ba'i tho sgrigs zhus shing / gsal byed kyang mdzad/ rin po che tshogs bsgom kun dga' dpal bzang po/ chos rje pa nyid lo bcu gsum bsten nas/ bshad sgrub spel mar mdzad cing / bde mchog skor la yig 'jog kyang dum tsam mdzad la/ gsung ngag la'ang / dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi khrid yig sogs cung zad yod gsungs/ grub thob yon tan dpal bzang pos ni/ chos rje pa'i gzim g.yog lo drug mdzad nas/ mthar kho bo skye ran tsa na skyes/ chos rje pa lta bu dang mjal/ smin ran tsa na smin/ sgrub pa snying por byas/ da 'chi ran tsa na 'chi dus 'di'ang gsungs shing / 'khor rnams la yang / sgrub pa la nan tan gyis/ ma bde ba byung dus nga rang la dris/ sang tsa na za rgyu the tshom tsam las mi yong gsung ba'i bka' gnang mdzad/ chos rje pa la rtogs pa phul bas 'di mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes yin/ da mtshon bya don gyi ye shes kyang myur du 'char bar gda' gsungs/ 'phags pa rin po che la da bdag gis nyams blangs ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ rtag tu lta ba bskyang zhing ting 'dzin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor mchog la yang yang dbang blang zhing / /phyag rgya chen po'i lam nas 'pho ba yin/ /ting nge 'dzin la rtag tu brtson bgyid pa/ /khyed kyis bgyi ba lags par bdag gis 'khum/ /zhes pa gnang zhing / zab mo mdo lnga'i lung yang 'phags pas zhus/ mdor na spyi'i sen mo rar/ rje pa'i gdung bzhugs pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten zhig dpyil ston mched kyis bzhengs 'dug pa gnas de la sogs pa dben gnas mchog rnams su/ sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa kho na las yig 'jog 'di mdzad bya ba ni med gsungs/

sku'i dbon 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni se ston ri pa'i sku skyer yang grags te/ de yang / yab zangs tshas tshogs bdag bsgrubs pas/ tshogs bdag gis glang po che'i sna rtser khur nas/ ri rab kyi rtser bskyel te ltos shig zer bas/ zangs tsha skrag nas ring zhig lta ba'i nus pa ma byung / de nas dbus gtsang khams gsum sogs bod kyi gzhung tal tsam gzigs pas/ khyod rang gis gang mthong ba dbang du 'du ba yin pa la/ dbus gtsang khams gsum sogs khyed kyi bu'am tsha rgyud kyis dbang du 'du ba gcig 'byung / myur du ma mthong bas/ khyod rang la ni dbang thang med zer/ de nas kyang zangs tsha la sras yun ring du ma byung bas/ thugs zid thung nas/ tshogs bdag gnad la dbab pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pas/ skabs gcig gi tshe/ glang thang du se ston ri pa'i rtsar tshogs bdag byung nas/ zangs tshas nga la dbus gtsang khams gsum dbang du 'du ba gcig dgos zer nas/ rgyab tshags mig ltar so so bskul ba yin pas/ khong rang la ni dbang ri mi 'dug kho'i bur khyed skye ba bzhes na 'du ba 'dug pas bsam zhing skye ba blang dgos zer nas de bzhin mdzad pa yin gsungs/ de lta bu'i tshogs grub dbon gsum gyi brgyud pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'dus pa ni/ grub chen brag phug pa yin te de yang zhang dkon mchog dpal bas thog mar grub thob pa la gsung ngag yongs su rdzogs pa thob par gnyis pa rin chen rgyal mtshan las gsung ngag rdzogs par gsan nas/ de'i rjes su dge slong kun blo dang gnyis kyis mdo khams tso mdo'i bar du bsnyegs nas/ 'phags pa rin po che las gsan pa yin la/ de la brag phug pas gsan pa gnyis/ yang tshogs sgom pa'i slob ma mnyan chen bsod nams bstan pa la'ang brag phug pas gsan pas gsum car 'dus pa'o/ /yang tshogs grub dbon gsum gyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa la/ la nyan zhang gsum zhes grags te/ de yang la ru gser khang du sku 'khrungs pa la ru ba bsod nams seng ges/

thog mar shar pa rdo rje 'od zer la rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gsan nas/ lam 'bras lam skor dang bcas pa'i bshad pa lag len nyams rtogs dang bcas pa la rang bas lhag pa med snyam pa mdzad/ phyis grub thob pa'i snyan pa gsan nas/ spyi'i sen mo rar grub thob pa la gdams pa lo gsum gsan/ mdog gi rje rong dbyag gi mkhar du sku 'khrungs pa'i nyan chen bsod nams bstan pas/ bla ma tshogs lo bcu gsum bsten/ dger phu nas byon pa'i tshe/ da chos 'di mnyan bya ba dang / sgro 'dogs 'di chod bya ba gcig kyang med gsungs/ 'dis mdzad zer ba'i khrid yig kyang yod/ de lta bu'i la nyan gnyis la 'chad la spangs kha ba grags pa dpal kyis gsan/ des sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ des theg chen chos rje/ des 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan las brgyud pa'i rgyun/ brgyud pa gsum ldan 'di la yod do/ /spang khang kun mkhyen gangs khrod pas mdzad pa'i lam 'bras chos 'byung sogs yig 'jog kyang mang du byung / 'di la brgyud pa'i chu bo mang du bzhugs te/ la nyan gnyis la dngos su brgyud pa'i tshogs grub kyi brgyud pa/ yang la nyan gnyis la don mo ri pa grags pa dpal gyis gsan cing de la'ang gangs pas gsan/ yang gnyan snying po rgyal mtshan gyis tshogs bsgom pa la gsan/ gnyag gi mang mkhar rta lung pa bkra shis bzang po dang / ja tsha lung pa rgyal mtshan dpal gnyis la gnang zhing / snga ma la'ang gangs pas gsan/ phyi ma de la/ chos rje bla ma dam pas/ lam sbas bshad kyi 'khrul 'khor sogs cha lag du ma gsan pa yin no/ /ko brag pas khams chen byang chub dpal/ des 'dzim pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ de la'ang gangs pas zha lugs kyi lam 'bras gsan la/ gangs pas 'di la zha lugs gnang bya ba med pas rgyun chad dam gsungs/ yang tshogs bsgom pas mnyag snying po rgyal mtshan/ des bar ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ rgyal rgan thugs rje bsod nams mang po la spel/

rgen rgan gyi gzhung bshad yod/ bar ston la bar phug pa gcig dang / shab bar sdengs pa gnyis yod pa'i/ bar ston phyi ma 'di chos rje bla ma dam pa'i gsol dpon yun ring du byas pa de yin/ bar ston snga ma ni 'di nyid yin te/ 'dis chos 'byung zhib mo rnam 'thag dang / dbang bzhi ngo sprod kyi byin rlabs/ de'i dmigs rim/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi zin bris/ dmar ma'i gsal byed du 'gro ba'i zin bris sogs yig cha mang po 'byung / tshogs bsgom pa'i slob ma klam kar ba seng ge rgyal mtshan dang / mnyag snying po rgyal mtshan gnyis khar gyi khrid yig re'ang yod do/ /de lta bu'i tshogs grub gnyis po bsgrubs pa'i brgyud 'dzin yin mod/ nyams len gyi srol cung zad mi 'dra ba ste/ tshogs pa ni thun bzhi'i dbang la gtso bor byed/ grub pa ni rlung 'khrul 'khor la gtso bar byed pa yin gsungs te/ tshogs grub gnyis nas 'phel ba'i tshul mdo tsam mo/ /chos rje pa'i dbon po 'phags pa rin po ches/ rgya nag gi 'gro don khad 'gyangs pa'i 'byon bzhud brel ba dang / gsung ngag rin po che'i tshogs gting dpag dka' ba nas/ cha lag yongs su rdzogs shing brgyud pa zin pa ches mang ba rang ma byung mod/ 'byon bzhugs kyi mdzo 'gros dang bstun pas rgyud dang man ngag spel ba las/ man ngag mdzo 'gros ma'i bka' bla ma zhang dkon mchog dpal ba la babs pas/ man ngag gi rgyun 'chug med du 'phel ba 'di yin la/ rgyud bshad mdzo 'gros ma'i bka' ni sga ldan pa bkra shis dpal la babs zhes gsungs so/ /'phags pa nyid kyis mdzad do zhes grags pa'i gzhung bshad 'phags mdzad mar grags pa gcig yod la/ gzhan yang bdag 'jug la sogs pa'i yig cha mang po mdzad do/ /gzhan yang chos rje pa'i slob ma zhang bya ru ba ārya de ba'i khrid yig yod la/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas dang / de'i gcung rdo rje 'od zer te gnyis las gcen rje pa'i slob ma'ang yin/

gcen gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad cung ma tshar ba'i 'phro gcung gis kha bskangs pa gcig kyang yod cing / gtsang nags phug pa shes rab 'od zer gyis dang por chos rje pa la dgag pa mdzad pas yi dam ma dgyes pa'i rnam pa bstan nas thugs 'gyod de bshags shing / mthar chos rje pa la gsung ngag zhus/ 'phags pa la'ang gdams pa 'ga' gsan nas chos rje khu dbon gnyis cha la bstod pa tshigs bcad dang / gzhung bshad sprin bral nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba mdzad gsungs/ spyir gtsang nags phugs pa la/ cha pa'i seng chen brgyad kyi nang tshan brtson 'grus seng ge jo nang kun spangs zhang gi slob ma bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi gsol 'debs mdzad mkhan thugs rje seng ge chos rje khu dbon gyi slob ma 'jam dbyangs nags phugs pa shes rab 'od zer dang gsum yod gsungs/ yang chos rje pa'i slob ma mang / 'di'i gnas cha khungs na yod/ mang mkhar glang ra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis kyang / gsung ngag bshad cing yig cha yod la/ 'di la lcang ra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes bris pa dpe ma dag pa yin zhes bdag chen rin po ches gsungs shing / yang chos rje pa'i slob ma lung phu ba bsod nams rin chen gyis/ bsam sding pa gzhon nu grub dang / bkras lung pa shākya dpal gnyis la bshad/ gzhon nu grub ni/ shangs pa bka' brgyud pa 'jag bsam gnyis kyi zlas phye ba de yin no/ /bkras lung pas/ red mda' pa zhang byang bzhed la gnang zhing / de nyid la chos rje bla ma dam pas cha lag 'ga' zhus pa yin gsungs te chos rje pa khu dbon la sogs pas gsung ngag rin po che shin tu nye rgyud la sogs pa dar bar mdzad pa'i tshul mdo tsam mo/ /'o na chos rje pa khu dbon gyi bstan pa'i rgyun 'dzin pa po su zhig snyam na/ chos rje pa'i gsung ngag 'dzin pa la tshogs grub dbon gsum gtso che la/ tshogs grub gnyis kyi rgyun yang zam ma chad pa yin mod/ gtso bo 'phags pa rin po che yin zhing de nyid kyi gsung ngag gi rgyun 'dzin pa ni zhang dkon mchog dpal ba kho na yin no/

/zhang pa la bu slob mang du 'dus kyang / rgyun 'dzin gyi gtso bo grub chen brag phug pa nyid du nges la/ rgyun ma chad tsam ni/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod dang / spro lung pa kun smon gnyis la'ang yod de/ de gnyis kyis zhang pa la zhus shing dpal ldan seng ge la gnang ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la brgyud nas zam ma chad pa'o/ /dga' ldan pas lam 'bring po'i khrid dang / nang dkyil gyi khrid dmigs sogs yod la/ skro lung pa'i/ mnyag ma'i zin bris/ mnyag ma'i gsal byed a seng ma'i 'grel pa sogs yod gsungs/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal bas/ yig cha tsam ma mdzad kyang / rgyud man ngag la khong gi phyag len la yod med ces zhu dag byed pa kho na byung zhing / de nyid kyi gsung gi rgyun 'dzin/ gtso bor chos rje bla ma dam pa nyid yin la/ gzhan yang brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ brag phug pa blo gros bstan pa sogs mang du byung ba las/ brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la sa skya bu ston dbang phyug dar ram rgyal po g.yag sde ba nam mkha' bsod nams blo bzang dkar por grags pa/ khams kyi gtso mo dpal 'bar gyi thim chu ba blo gros dkar po sogs kyis gsan pa yin la/ sa skya bu ston nas theg chen pa/ g.yag sde ba nas/ brtse chen pa grub chen kun blo las brgyud de brgyud pa gsum ldan 'di la zam ma chad pa'o/ /thim chu ba blo gros dkar po la khams su gon gyo ba ye shes dpal gyis tshar gcig gsan pas/ brag phug pa'i snyan pa gsan nas/ stod la byon/ brag phug la dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la lam 'bras zhus/ snang gsum rdzogs rjes brag phug pa zhi bar gshegs nas/ ri khrod pa blo brtan la rdzogs par gsan pa yin la/ de lta bu'i lam 'bras pa blo bzang dkar po dang / ye shes dpal gnyis char la khams kyi chab la kha ba lam 'bras pa blo bzang dkar mos gsan nas/ mang mkhar du spel ba las/ lam 'bras pa blo bzang grags pa sogs byung ba yin no gsungs so/

/dbang gi mtshams sbyor gyi bshad pa brag phug pa dkon rgyal kho na bzang la/ 'on kyang 'dra min cung zad yod pas 'byed shes pa gcig ni dgos gsungs/ lam 'bras pa ye shes pa la/ mkhan chen g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal ba gsung ngag 'di gsan no/ /chos rje bla mas ni dpal ldan seng ge la'ang gsan mod/ gtso bor grub chen brag phug pa'i thugs sras mchog tu gyur pa yin pa la/ kun mkhyen gangs pas/ sa paṇa gyi bum pa gang byo tshogs grub gnyis la yod/ de gnyis kyi bum pa gang byo de dpon slob la yod pas/ de don re grags chen dang dpon slob gung la thug par 'os snyam du dgongs mod/ gdung rgyud so so'i rab 'dzin dgongs par 'thad mi 'thad kyis ma yin gyi/ tshogs grub dbon gsum gyi rgyud pa 'dus ma 'dus kyis yin gsungs/ chos rje dpal ldan seng ges/ zhang pa'i slob ma/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ skro lung pa kun smon gnyis dang / nyan chen po'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rdo rje gsum la gsan/ chos rje bla dam pa la/ sngags kyi rgyal tshab gnyis zhes grags te/ snye thang pa shes rab gnang ba dang / yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan no/ /yar lung pa chos rje pa'i gsung la zin bris byas pa'i po ti yang mang du byung / gsung gi rgyud 'dzin ni/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje gzungs pa/ chos rje nya dbon chen po/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ jo nang pa mkhan chen byang chub seng ge lo chen byang chub rtse mo sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon la/ chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa/ na bza' las mtshan thogs pa lam 'bras pod nag mar grags pa yod cing / chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis/ thog mar ri khrod pa/ de mtshams dkar brag la'ang gsan mod/ rjes su rje 'di nyid la yun ring gtugs nas/ brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bor bzhugs so/ /chos rje gzungs pas/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ des mnga' ris pa rgyal mtshan dkon mchog

des chos rje rdo rje rgyal mtshan nas spel lo/ /'o na de dag gi rjes su brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bor gyur pa ni su zhig snyam na/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gsung ngag rin po che'i nyi 'od/ glo bur nyid du chos ltar lhags pa'i chu 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bur khyebs pa tsam du cha ba na/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rlung zer gyis phas kyi chu 'dzin bsal te/ gsung ngag rin po che'i tsha zer rma med pa'i 'od 'byin par mdzad pa ni/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po kho na yin la/ 'di nyid kyis thog mar shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan yun ring du bsten pa yin na'ang / shar chen pa nyid chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims la gsung ngag rdzogs pa'i gtso bo shar chen pa buddha bhi mi mnyag rin chen 'dre'o/ /gsum zhes grags pa'i ya gyal gcig yin pas/ bka' rgya lo bco brgyad bsdams nas gces par bskyangs pa na/ sku tshe ring du ma 'tsho bas/ gsung ngag gi khog sgrigs pa tsam dang / cha lag 'ga' tsam las lam yongs rdzogs gsan rgyu ma byung / phyis lo chen skyabs mchog la snang gsum tsam gsan rjes/ mnal lam gyi brdas bskul te/ grub chen buddha shrī la phul du phyin par gsan nas bshad bka' khrid bka' mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len sogs ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas/ gsung ngag rin po che nyi 'od lham me bshad pa 'di yin no/ /rje de nyid kyi rgyud 'dzin ni 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug gung ru shes rab bzang po/ zha lu mkhyen rab chos rje/ gu ge paṇa chen grags rgyal sogs bgrang bar mi bzod pa byon yang / gtso bor mus chen sems dpa' chen po nyid yin no/ /rje 'di nyid ni/ dag pa'i gdul bya zha lu mkhyen rab la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nyid du gsal bar snang zhing / gsung ngag rin po che'i rgyun che cher spel ba'i slob ma'i mchog kyang mang du byung mod/

mchog dam pa ni bdag chen rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nyid yin te/ gsung ngag gi 'od zer 'byin pa'i rgyu skar gyi bstan 'dzin bye ba'i tshogs nang / gsung ngag slob bshad kyi tsha zer spro ba'i phrin las dang ldan zhing / tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cha shas yongs su rdzogs nas dbri bar mi nus pa ni dam pa 'di kho nar rag las pas so/ /de bas na skabs kyi gtso bo rang re'i rgyud pa 'di ji ltar byung zhing 'phel snyam na/ 'di nyid ni brgyud pa rmad du byung ba gsum dang ldan par byung ste/ dang por yab 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa/ bar du 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po nas brgyud pa/ mthar rje sems dpa' chen po nas brgyud de byung ba'o/ /dang po la yang brgyud pa gnyis 'dus te/ yab bla chen kun rgyal nas brgyud pa rin chen sgang pa'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa las rim par byon pa dang / theg chen pa nas brgyud pa'o/ /theg chen pa la'ang gnyis 'dus te/ tshogs grub gnyis kyi brgyud pa 'dus pa spang kha ba las bka' drin thob pa sa bzang ma ti pa las gsan pa dang / 'phags pa rin po che'i rgyud 'dzin brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan las bka' drin thob pa sa skya bu ston las gsan pa'o/ /'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang pos brtse chen kun blo la gsan cing de la'ang brgyud pa gnyis te/ brag phug pa dkon rgyal gyi slob ma g.yag sde pa las gsan pa dang / bla ma dam pa'i slob bu nya dbon kun dga' dpal la gsan pa'o/ /gsum pa sems dpa' chen po'i brgyud pa ni rdo rje 'chang kho na las gzhan med do/ /de lta bu'i brgyud pa gsum po de ni rnyed dka' zhing don dang ldan pa kho na yin te/ yab mes bla chen nas brgyud pa dang / nya dbon sogs nas brgyud pa ni 'di kho nar nges la/ theg chen pas chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogs la'ang gnang mod/

chos rje bsod nams bzang po ba nas/ rdo rje gdan pa chos rje kun dga' rnam rgyal la brgyud pa/ 'di da lta bzhugs la/ 'on kyang theg chen pa'i bka' 'bum po ti gnyis tsam yod pa 'di'i lung rgyun bzhugs pa ni/ brgyud pa 'di pa kho na yin gsungs/ 'o na rje sems dpa' chen po nas brgyud pa ni/ deng sang dpal ldan ngor pa'i zhal 'dzin thams cad ma yin nam ji ltar dkon snyam na/ de ltar bden mod kyi/ dpal ldan sa skya'i snyan brgyud gdams pa'i nying khu thams cad bsdus pa'i khyad par gyi gnad zab rgu man ngag slob bshad kyi bka' drin gsal bar thob nas 'dzin pa ni brgyud pa 'di kho na pas mchog tu dkon zhing / rnyed na don yod pa kho na yin te/ de yang spyir rgyud dngos bstan gyis zin pa'i slob bshad ni gsang 'dus nyid la yod la/ des ma zin yang bde mchog lta bu la'ang / rje nā ro pas pham thing pa kho na la slob bshad mdzad pa'i rgyun da lta rang re sa skya pa la rgyun ma chad par yod cing / de bzhin du rgyud gsum la yang slob bshad yod pa 'di yin la/ man ngag slob bshad ni/ zab rgu'i gnad dam pa gab pa'i tshul gyis brgyud pa'i rim pa la yod pa kho na yin mod/ slob bshad kyi tha snyad gsal bar phyung nas don ma nor bar 'dzin pa ni/ bdag chen rin po che nyid nas yin te/ de yang rje ngor chen gyi dngos slob gung ru dang / srad pa sogs kyis kyang / slob bshad la bshad pa 'di dang 'di 'dra byed ces bshad pa'i na yam cung zad bris pa yod la/ rje mus chen gyi dngos slob/ zha lu ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang la sogs pas/ rje mus chen cung zad thugs nyams 'ur te sku'i mdangs 'gyur zhing / btub na 'di tsam yin gsungs pa'i bshad lugs thor cha mdzad pa'i tshe/ dus de tsam na slob bshad byung ngo zhes rang rang gis zin bris mdzad pa'i yi ge dum tsam yod de/ spyir ni/ rje zha lu bas/ rje mus chen tha na bdag 'jug tsam mdzad pa'i tshe yang /
