drung du 'khod pa'i go skabs zhus nas/ rdo rje gsum gyi rnam pa'i cha ma lus pa'i phyag len thams cad zin bris mdzad cing / deng sang lung rgyun yod pa'i po ti yang bzhi tsam yod gsungs des na bu slob gzhan rnams la ni rang rang gi slob bshad du go ba tsam las 'di slob bshad do zhes dngos kyis bka' gnang ba ni med la/ bdag chen rin po che la ni/ mus sta mo'i gnas nyid du zla ba bzhi'i bar la tshogs pa spyi dang bstun nas tshogs bshad/ dgong ja'am srod ja gung gi steng du rje nyid kho na la slob bshad mdzad de/ slob tshogs kyi bshad pa gnyis kar dus gcig nyid du nod nas gsung ngag rin po che'i bstan pa ches gsal bar mdzad de/ sa bzang dgon par zla ba bco brgyad kyi bar/ tshogs pa stong tsam la gsung ngag slob bshad mdzad cing / yongs su rdzogs pa'i lung sbyin pa'i dus su/ btsun ma gcig dang bcu gcig tsam byung ba yin la/ spyir ni gsung ngag tshar nyi shu rtsa lnga gnang ba yin gsungs te/ de lta bu'i dam pa de nyid ni/ zhabs sa la ma reg par 'byon pa dang / lus dkyil gyi lha brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun gsal bar gzigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan mang du yod mod/ yang dag par na 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bo bla chen sa skya pa nyid slar yang zlos te byon pa yin pas/ de tsam la ya cha bar bya dgos pa ga la yin te/ mtha' yas pa'o/ /de nyid kyi gsung ngag gi bstan 'dzin ni/ rje btsun rdo rings pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma kho na yin te/ rje de nyid la gsung ngag slob bshad tshar gcig dang tshogs bshad tshar bzhi gsan nas sgrub pa snying por mdzad de/ bka' srung bran ltar 'khul zhing / rdo dril mkha' la 'jog pa sogs ngo mtshar ba mang du yod cing / yang dag nyid du phag mo grub pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa ste/ gsung ngag tshar nyi shu lhag tsam gsungs nas dar bar mdzad pa'o/ /rje dam pa de nyid kyi gsung ngag gi rgyun 'dzin ni/

mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan ma lus par ldan pa rje btsun blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po kho na yin te/ rje de nyid la gsung ngag slob bshad tshar gnyis tshogs bshad tshar gsum gsan/ ji lta ji snyed kyi gnas thams cad thugs su chud pa/ lam zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis sa lam thams cad chig chod du song nas tshig don gyi mdud pa thams cad rang sar grol te/ tshig don phyag len sogs phra rags gang la yang nor 'khrul gyi dri ma med pas skal ldan gyi gdul bya bslu ba med par mdzad pa 'di yin no/ /de dag gi zhar la bsres rgyud ji ltar byung ba cung zad kyang gsungs te/ sa chen gyi dngos slob phag gru pas/ sa chen lo bcu gnyis bsten nas/ rnam 'grel bshad mdzod ma mdzad cing / de'i slob ma pradzña karti sogs kyi de nyid la 'grel bshad kyang yod/ phyis phag gru pas/ phyag chen nā ro chos drug lam 'bras sogs bsres pa'i yig cha/ gsang sngags lam rim bya ba yod gsungs/ yang sa chen gyi dngos slob rgyal tsha tal phug pas/ rta nag lce bsgom la gnang zhing / de rnying ma dang bka' brgyud dang / lam 'bras rnams bsres nas yod la/ spyir lce bsgom la/ rta nag lce bsgom dang / dbus kyi kha reg lce bsgom sogs yod pa la/ 'di ni rta nag lce bsgom/ mkha' skyong brag par grags pa nyid de ma gcig re ma dang phan tshun dpon slob yin/ tal phug pa dang / lce bsgom gnyis gcig tu 'dzin pa ni/ dpe ngor chen chos 'byung la la'i yi ge'i bcod 'chis ma phyed pa'i 'khrul gzhi'o gsungs kyang bla ma cha gan dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyis/ sa zha bsres pa'i gzhung bshad bka' rgya ma sogs lam 'bras pod longs kyi yig cha mang dag mdzad de/ khong pas sa lugs ni sa paṇa gyi dngos slob pu rangs pa la gsan cing / zha lugs ni bshad pa 'jam dbyangs chen po rin chen rgyal mtshan 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog par grags pa de nyid la gsan pa yin la/

'jam dbyangs chen pos/ sa lugs ni 'phags pa la'ang rigs rim gsan mod/ yongs su rdzogs pa gtsang nags phug pa shes rab 'od zer la gsan pa yin no/ de lta bu'i cha gan des gsung ngag mang po la gsungs kyang / khong pa'i brgyud pa gtsang mar 'dzin pa ni/ bla chen grags pa rgyal mtshan yin la/ des ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan la gnang zhing / si tu bas gsung ngag 'chad do gsung ba'i gad rgyangs ci yang bsgrags mod/ spel thub pa ni ma byung gsungs/ yang jo nang pa kun spangs kun tu bzang pos/ sa lugs zha lugs sbrom lugs kyi jo lugs sogs thams cad bsres nas bshad la/ des ngab byar ba rin chen 'od zer la gsan cing / des shar pa 'jim chen la gsan pa yin mod/ khong gis bsres lugs de snga mas cung ma 'chi ste/ sbrom lugs dang gyi jo lugs brgyud pa med bzhin du bsres pas so gsungs/ yang de'i slob ma la stod dbang rgyal gyis/ lam 'bras sbyor drug dang bsres nas gnad mang po bcos pas snga ma bas kyang ches tshabs che ba gcig yod gsungs te/ bsres brgyud ji ltar byung ba mdo tsam mo/ /lam 'bras brgyud pa'i rim pa dang bcas pa ji ltar byung tshul ngo mtshar ba'i cha shas bla ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi lags so/ /tshim par rol cig gnyis pa byung ba'i chos la bshad sgrub bya tshul la gsum/ bshad sgrub bya gzhi chos ngos bzung ba/ tshad ma bzhi'i sgo nas bshad pas sgro 'dogs gcod tshul/ snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgo nas sgrub pas nyams su blang tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum/ rjod byed tshig gi lam 'bras/ brjod bya don gyi lam 'bras/ ston byed yi ge'i rnam grangs so/ /dang po ni/ 'bras bu sku bzhi ye shes lnga/ thob byed smin grol 'khor bcas ma tshang ba med par ston pa 'di nyid de/ gzhan dus 'khor sbyor drug gsang 'dus rim lnga/ bde mchog rim bzhi la sogs pa ni/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi gdams ngag tsam yin pas lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa ma yin la/

byang sa dang / nyan sa sogs las/ byang sems kyi lam 'bras dang / nyan thos kyi lam 'bras zhes ming btags pa tsam yod mod don dang ldan pa ma yin no/ /de bas na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung ngag zab mo mdo sde dang rgyud sde thams cad kyi don gyi bcud phyung ba/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pa'i gsung rab/ mdo rgyud ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ mkhas pa rnams kyis bgrod par bya ba'i 'jug ngogs/ bsod nams dang mi ldan pa rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa rnams kyi them skas/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin ston par byed pa'i tshig phun sum tshogs pa 'di ni bshad sgrub kyi gzhi rjod byed tshig gi lam 'bras so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'bras bu lam dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag gcig shes pas mang po shes pa'i gdam ngag skyon yon tan du slong ba'i gdam ngag bar chad dngos grub tu len pa'i gdam ngag ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel ba'i gdam ngag bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel ba'i gdam ngag gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu'i gdam ngag rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang / sde snod gsum gyi de nyid/ gzhung chung yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i gdam ngag 'di ni bshad sgrub bya ba'i gzhi brjod bya'i lam 'bras so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ spyir glegs bam ji ltar byung tshul/ khyad par glegs bam chos sna'i grangs/ po ti dmar chung gi chos sna'i grangs bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bla chen sa skya'i dus/ lam 'bras kyi dpe gseg gi sgam chung du bzhugs su gsol bas/ lam 'bras gseg shugs mar grags pa byung / rje btsun gyi sku tshe'i stod la na bza' dar gos ser po'i sbubs su bzhugs su gsol bas/ lam 'bras pod ser mar grags pa byung /

phyis rje pas mnyag ma'i zhal shes dgu sogs yig chung gis kha bskangs te/ dkar chag gi thems kyis bsdams nas/ lam 'bras glegs bam du bsgrigs te/ glegs shing gi phyi la rdo rje 'bri ste/ rtogs shing phyed par dka' ba mtshon/ nang la nor bu 'bri ste/ 'dod rgu stsol bar mtshon/ rgyas par ni bla ma brgyud pa'ang 'bri ste/ bla ma la bsten nas rtogs dgos par bstan pa'o/ /rje pa'i dkar chag la ma ltos pa'i lam 'bras glegs bam yang du ma zhig snang ste/ dkar shākya grags kyis kho rang gis mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad rtsa bar byas te/ yig chung gzhan dag gis kha bskangs pa'i lam 'bras glegs bam dang / zhang ze dmar bas/ mnyag ma rtsa bar byas te/ yig chung gzhan dag gis kha bskangs pa'i lam 'bras glegs bam sogs yod gsungs so/ /yang lam 'bras pod dmar ma dang / pod nag ma zhes grags pa ni/ na bza' gos chen dmar nag las thogs pa ste/ deng sang po ti dmar chung zhes grags pa 'di dang / bla ma dam pa'i gzhung bshad man ngag gter mdzod/ khrid yig bzhi sogs glegs bam du dril ba 'di gnyis la rim pa ltar bya la/ mdzad pa po'i mtshan thogs pa dmar gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad gsung bgros ma la'ang dmar mar grags te/ dmar gyis mdzad pa'i yig chung du ma'ang yod mod/ gzhung bshad kyi gsal byed du sbyar nas 'chad pa'am glegs bam du bsgrigs pa ni med gsungs/ gnyis pa glegs bam chos sna'i grangs ston pa ni/ glegs bam dkar chag 'di nyid klad don/ gzhung don/ mjug don gsum du bsdus nas 'chad pa las/ dang po la mchod brjod dang dam bca' ba gnyis te/ phal cher bklags pas go la/ glegs bam gyi za ma tog ces pa nor bu bzhugs pa'i snod za ma tog ltar/ dkar chag 'dis bcos par bsdams pa'i chos rnams ni/ 'dod rgu stsol ba'i nor bu lta bu yin la/ de nyid bsre bslad sogs kyis chud mi za bar byed pa'i snod lta bu yin pas so/

/gnyis pa gzhung don ni/ spyir glegs bam dkar chag 'di la/ snga rtsom dang phyi rtsom gnyis/ dang po ni rten 'brel don bsdus/ lta ba rtsa 'grel rnams med pa gcig bzhugs la/ phyi rtsom la'ang / mchan dkyus shor legs po min pa gcig snang ste/ ji skad du/ de ltar na lam rgyas pa'i cha lag yi ge dkar chag la thebs pa drug cu tham pa ste/ glegs bam 'dir cis kyang 'bri dgos pa zhe dgu/ dpe chung lnga dang bcas pa yod do/ /zhes pa 'di/ mchan dkyus shor du snang zhing / legs par yang mi sems te/ drug cu po lam rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum thams cad kyi chos sna yin pas/ lam rgyas pa'i chos sna kho nar ma nges pa'i phyir dang / las dang gi chos sna bdun byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa sogs logs su bzhugs chog pa'ang mang dag snang bas/ 'dir cis kyang bzhugs dgos pa zhe dgu'ang cung zad dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na phyi rtsom nyid gtso bor bzung nas/ chos sna drug bcu'i grangs 'dren tshul la mi 'tsham pa mang yang / 'dir rang re'i brgyud pas/ bdag chen rin po che'i gsung bzhin 'di ltar mdzad pa/ nyung ngu'i sdom gyis bsdus na/ rtsa ba'i gzhung dang rnam 'grel thog mtha' gnyis/ /gsal byed nyer gnyis 'phros don bcu dang bdun/ /rtsa ba med dang yod pa'i 'bring dang bsdus/ /gzhung shing rnam bzhi rtogs bskyed rnam pa lnga/ /rtogs gsal des chung zab mo bla ma'i lam/ /lung sbyor rnam gsum rgya bod lo rgyus gnyis/ /brgyud pa 'di las byon pa'i glegs bam gyi/ /chos sna drug cu'i grangs yin 'khrul pa med/ /rdo rje'i tshig dang rtogs gsal dor nas ni/ /yi ge med pa'i lung sbyor rgyas pa dang / /phra mo'i dkar chag rnam gnyis 'dren pa dang / /grangs kyi gtso bo rtsa ba'i gzhung dor nas/ /mi 'os glegs bam phra mo 'dren pa sogs/ /brgyud pa gzhan gyi lugs yin 'dir mi bzhed/ /de ltar sdom gyis bsdus nas/

don lhug par dkrol na/ rtsa ba'i gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang / rnam 'grel gnyag ma dang / a seng ma/ gsal byed la/ kun gzhi'i yig chung / gdan gyi yig chung / nang dkyil gyi… 'chi ltar 'khrul 'khor 'chi bslu snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' ka ma ste bum dbang gi 'da' kha ma'i yig chung / gsang dbang gi thig le'i rnal 'byor gyi/ shes rab ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid kyi… bzhi pa'i 'da' ka ma bum dbang dang thun mong du yi ges sgo dgag pa dang bcas pa'i… bar do bzhi'i… lam dbang gi… tshad ma bzhi'i… gdams ngag drug gi… rten 'brel lnga'i… grib ma khrus kyis sel ba'i… de tsha tshas sel ba'i… grib sel gyi sbyin sreg bsdus pa'i… thig le 'dzag pa bsrungs pa'i… yi ge brgya pa 'don thabs kyi yig chung ste 'khor 'das thun mong gi skabs su bcu bdun/ rlung sbyor bdun gyi dang / bha ga yi ge bcu bzhi ste 'khor lo 'cham pa la gnyis/ gsang dbang gi skabs su 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ bzhi pa dbang phyug gi don brgyad/ sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed rog ma'i mngon rtogs te/ 'das lam gyi skabs su gsum ste gsal byed nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /'phros don la/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud las 'phros nas/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba rtsa 'grel thabs rgyud kyi gdan sogs las 'phros nas/ dbang bzhi'i cho ga mdor bsdus pa'i man ngag gi gnad/ mchog dbang gsum grol ba'i lam la brten nas bskur ba/ dbang chu chen mo yum gyi byin rlabs kyi rgyud pa ma nyams pa ste bzhi/ lam sogs la 'phros nas yab kyi bskyed rim rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ yum gyi bskyed rim/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg ste lnga/ dam tshig gi la 'phros nas/ srung ba'i dam tshig rtsa ltung 'khrul spong / rgyun gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig tshogs 'khor/ khyad par gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa ste gsum/ srung ba sum bcu dang / man ngag gi gnad bdun bcu la 'phros nas/

byung rgyal du mi btang ba'i gnad bzhi/ bsam gtan 'dod pa'i 'phrang bdun/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyis bsal ba/ 'phrin las so gnyis te gegs sel bzhi dang bcas pa'i bcu bdun no/ /lam 'bring bsdus gnyis ni/ rtsa ba'i gzhung logs pa med pa dang / logs pa tshigs bcad gcig tsam yod pa'o/ /gzhung shing bzhi ni/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin gyi khrid/ gnad drug gis bkri ba'i khrid/ gnad bcu gcig gis bkri ba'i khrid/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum du bkri ba'i khrid de bzhi'o/ /rtogs bskyed lnga ni/ lam 'jug ldog phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag bdun/ lam bsre ba'i 'gros bzhi dang bcas pa dang / phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis te lnga'o/ /rtogs gsal gyi dpe bris la 'chi ltas kyi 'khrul 'khor gnyis/ rtsa'i dpe bris/ bha ga yi ge bcu gcig gi dpe bris/ phrin las so gnyis kyi dpe bris/ gegs sel gzhan gyi dpe bris gnyis rnams yod mod grangs gcig tu bsdu/ zab mo'i lam ni/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ lung sbyor la/ lung 'di nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba/ lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba/ lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba ste gsum/ rgya bod kyi lo rgyus la/ bla ma brgyud pa rgya gar ba dang / bod rnams kyi lo rgyus te gnyis so/ /de ltar drug cu la/ rdo rje tshig rkang nges par 'dren dgos te/ man ngag 'di'i chos kyi rtsa ba yin pa dang / rje pa'i yab chos kyi dkar chag rgyud kyi dkar chag man ngag gi dkar chag rnams yod pa las/ gzhan rnams su 'di ma bcug pas/ man ngag dkar chag 'dir mi 'jug kha med yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na glegs bam 'dir cis kyang bzhugs dgos pa lnga bcu nga gcig logs su gzhugs dgos pa gnyis 'dir bzhugs kyang rung mi gzhugs kyang rung ba bdun te drug cu tham pa dkar chag 'di'i grangs la bzhugs pa yin no/

/gsum pa mjug gi don ni/ 'grel pa'i steng gi gsal byed nyi shu rtsa gnyis ni/ zhes sogs kyis bstan to/ /gnyis pa po ti dmar chung gi grangs ni/ tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar ba'i skabs las shes par nus pas 'dir ma bris so/ /gnyis pa tshad ma bzhis 'dogs gcod pa la bzhi/ de'i ngo bo/ go rim/ grangs nges/ chos sna thams cad tshad ma bzhis gtan la phab pa dngos/ dang po ni mi bslu ba ste/ bla mas gdams ngag la mi bslu/ nyams myong gis rang rang gi nyams skye ba la mi bslu/ bstan bcos kyis bka'i dgongs pa la mi bslu/ bkas rang gi bstan bya la mi bslu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ rgyud las bstan pa'i go rim/ thog mar 'byung ba'i go rim/ nyams su blang ba'i go rim/ nyams su myong ba'i go rim mo/ /dang po ni/ rang dgar 'jug pa spang ba'i phyir 'khrugs can te/ saṃ bhu ṭir/ bstan bcos tshad ma slob dpon nyid/ /lung gi rjes 'brang de nyid rig /de nyid gsang don dngos po yang / /gcig nas gcig brgyud shes par bya/ /bla ma rab kyi zhal las blangs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ dang por bka' tshad ma ste/ kun gyi thug sa mthar thug yin pas so/ /gnyis pa bstan bcos tshad ma ste/ bka'i dgongs pa 'grel pa la med thabs med pas so/ /gsum pa bla ma tshad ma ste/ bstan bcos kyi don ston par byed pa po yin pas so/ /bzhi pa nyams myong tshad ma ste/ bstan pa'i don nyams su blang dgos pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ dang por bla ma tshad ma ste/ nyams su len pa la bla ma tshad ma la mos gus 'jug pa gtso bo yin pas so/ /gnyis par gdams ngag gi nyams myong tshad ma ste/ bla mas bstan pa'i gdams ngag la snying rus kyis 'bad dgos pas so/ /gsum par bstan bcos tshad ma ste/ bstan pa ltar nyams myong skyes pa de/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gis zhus dag par byed pas so/ /bzhi par bka' tshad ma ste/ rdo rje'i tshig gis yid ches pa'i khungs yin pas so/ /bzhi pa ni/

dang por nyams myong tshad ma ste/ rang rgyud la nyams myong gsha' ma gcig ma skyes na/ bla ma dang bka' dang bstan bcos rnams tshad mar ji ltar bsgrubs kyang / go yul tsam las tshad ma'i nges shes gting tshugs pa gzhan gyis 'phrog mi nus pa gcig skye mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bla ma tshad ma ste/ rang rgyud kyi nyams kyi steng nas/ bla ma la mos gus thun mong min pa gcig skye bas so/ /gsum par bstan bcos tshad ma ste/ bla mas nyams bstan bcos dang sbyar te/ ngo sprad pas bstan bcos la yid lhag par ches pas so/ /bzhi par bka' tshad ma ste/ bstan bcos bka' dang sbyar bas bka' yang bslu ba med par shes pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar gyi gdul bya la ltos pa'i grangs nges te/ ston pa la dngos su thug pa'i gdul bya la tshad ma gnyis kyis chog bka'i dgongs pa rang dbang du 'grel ba'i gdul bya la/ tshad ma gsum gyis chog da ltar gyi gdul bya la bzhi las/ grangs mang mi dgos shing nyung na mi 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ sngar gyi chos sna drug cu po tshad ma bzhi ru 'di ltar gtan la dbab ste/ de yang nyams su len pa'i go rim dang bstun nas/ bla ma brgyud pa la mos gus tshud tshud sgom pa/ rang rgyud la nyams myong tshad ma bskyed pa/ de nyid lo rgyus tshad ma gzhung chung rdo rje tshig rkang dang sbyar ba/ de nyid bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma dang sbyar ba ste/ dang po ni/ bla ma rgya bod kyi lo rgyus so/ /gnyis pa la/ nyams ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa khrid kyi rnal 'byor/ skyes pa bogs 'byin pa rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga/ lam gyi bar chad sel ba gegs sel gyi yi ge chen po bzhi'o/ /dang po ni gzhung khrid bzhi'o/ /khrid de nyid la dgos pa/ dang por dam tshig dang / sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed pa smin byed dbang ste/ de'i yi ge dbang chu/ dbang chog mdor bsdus/ mchog dbang gsum gyi yi ge ste gsum/

thob pa mi nyams par srung ba dam tshig la/ bza' ba/ srung ba/ rten pa'i dam tshig gsum ste/ dang po la/ khyad par dang rgyun gnyis/ gnyis pa 'khrul spong / gsum pa rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor ste/ bskyed rim la yab kyi gsum/ yum gyi gcig gsang dbang gi mgor yum gyi byin rlabs bskyed rim gyi bya ba la/ dgos pa/ lta ba sbyin sreg gnyis te/ mdor na nyi shu rtsa drug po de'i sgo nas nyams myong tshad ma gcig rang rgyud la btsal la/ nam rnyed pa na bskyang bar bya'o/ /gsum pa bstan bcos tshad ma la gnyis/ gzhung rgyas par bshad pa dang / gzhung bsdus pa'o/ /dang po la'ang gnyis/ lam rgyas 'bring gsum du bstan pa dang / zab 'bring gsum du bstan pa'o/ /dang po gzhung chung rdo rje'i tshig rkang / gzhung bshad mnyag mas tshom bu bco brgyad du bkral ba'i don/ gsal byed yig chung nyer gnyis kyis brgyan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu/ ngo bo phan yon bar chad bsal ba stes mtshams tshom bu lngar bstan pa nyid do/ /gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor lnga la btud de bkruṃn/ /'bar g.yo brtan pa'i bye brag gis/ /srog rtsol 'gogs pa de bzhin du/ /bde chen chos sku nam mkha' bzhin/ /zhes pa'i don ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa zab 'bring gsum gyis/ tha ma lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa ni de dag thams cad yin la/ 'bring dam tshig gis 'gro ba yang gseb tshags su bstan tshar bas yi ge logs na med cing / rab bla mas 'gro ba la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gnyis pa don bsdus pa ni/ rnam 'grel a seng ma ste/ de ltar na bstan bcos tshad ma la yi ge nyer brgyad do/ /rtogs gsal dpe bris ni/ thad so thad sor 'gro'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ lung sbyor gsum ste/ chos sna drug cu tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni po ti dmar chung tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar ba la gsum/ ring rgyud nye rgyud rnam gnyis zhar byung dang bcas pa/

kha skong rje btsun ngor pa yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i chos sna tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni bla ma tshad ma la/ rgyud 'debs bla ma rnal 'byor 'dzin/ kha skong shar chen pas mdzad pa/ sa bir mjal ba'i lo rgyus sna theng la bskur ba ste gsum/ nyams myong tshad ma khrid yig bcad ma grwa ston zhus lan gsal bar grags pa/ smin byed sta gon skabs su sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su aṣṭa'i bzlas lung / de'i gsal byed aṣṭa'i gzhi bshad/ dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi 'byung ba/ lam dbang gi skabs dbang gi rab dbye/ dga' ston gdams yig gsang dbang gi sngon 'gro phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇḍal/ de'i gsal byed shar chen pas mdzad pa/ lus sbyor nyi shu'i gsal byed lam 'bras pa nor bzang gis mdzad pa/ lus gnad kyi man ngag gsang dbang gi dngos gzhi gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i dmigs pa rgyas pa/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa nyer dgu/ gegs sel la bar chad gsum sel/ gleng gzhi ma/ gsang 'dun ma/ bla ma chen po'i nyams chung ba/ nyams che ba/ khyad par gyi rlung rengs bcos pa/ gegs sel bzhi'i gsal byed/ gegs sel bka' rgya ma/ phrin las so gnyis kyi sdom tshig zhal shes/ dbang gi lta ba ngo sprod pa/ dbang bzhi ngo sprod rtsa 'grel te/ bstan bcos tshad ma la/ gnad du che ba drug rten 'brel lnga/ phyag chen dbye ba/ 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ tshogs sbyor mngon rtogs/ lam bsdus 'dod pa'i lcags kyu/ lam bsdus bshad pa/ sgrub pa lung sbyin/ gsang ba bcu'i rgyas gdab ste dgu'o/ /lung tshad ma la dmar gyis mdzad pa'i lung sbyor/ gnyis pa la gsum/ birwa pas sa chen la dngos su gnang ba/ sa chen gyis rje pa la mnal lam du gnang ba/ zhar byung dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhir grags pa ste/ lam zab/ lam sbas bshad/ bir srung / rnam 'jom bir lugs so/ /dang po ni/

sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dmar gyi bla ma rin 'byung gi man ngag ste gnyis/ gnyis pa ni/ lam sbas bshad kyi yi ge sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ pho brang lnga'i sbas bshad/ sbas bshad 'khrul 'khor so gnyis/ de'i gsal byed bhuddha shrī'i mdzad pa grub chen bcu/ phra mo brgyad rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ gsum ni sa chen gyi bir srung gi yig rnying gsum/ birwa pa'i sgrub thabs/ byin rlabs byed tshul gnyis/ 'phags pas mdzad pa ste lnga'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sa chen gyi rnam 'joms sgrub thabs/ de'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ sa paṇa gyi gzungs kyi mchan bu/ nub pa rig 'dzin grags kyi de'i phyag len te bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ brda don gsal ba ste/ sa chen gyi rtsa ba/ sa paṇa gyi 'grel pa/ lho pa'i gsal byed de gsum mo/ /gsum pa ni/ rje pa'i tshar gsum khug pa/ yig brgya'i las tshogs/ sgo drug chos 'grel rnams so/ /gsum pa kha skong la bzhi/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ rje sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa/ bdag chen rin po ches mdzad pa/ rje btsun bla ma mchog gis mdzad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ rgyud gsum lam rim sa bcad/ nang gi lam zab/ dbang bzhi'i rtogs skyed/ thun mong ba'i bir srung bar chad kun sel/ thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs/ mtshon don gsung ngag dang sbyar ba/ bir srung gsar ma/ sku'i rnam 'gyur drug ste brgyad/ yang gnad kyi zla zer/ rgyud gsum 'khrul 'joms/ lus dkyil rtsod spong smra ba ngan 'joms/ tshogs 'khor gsang ba kun rgyan/ gtor chog gi 'grel pa phrin las rgyas byed sogs kyang 'dir gsungs te mtha' yas pas so/ /gnyis pa ni gsung ngag gi khrid yig gnyis/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ dbang chu gsal ba'i me long / kha skong / sa chog lam dus dbang / gtor chog rnams bshad/ gsang ba'i lam zab/ grub mtha'i rnam 'byed/ bla ma'i rnam thar la sogs pa'o/

/gsum pa ni/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i rnam thar/ khrid yig zin bris/ brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed/ lam dus dbang chog bdud rtsi sgrub thabs/ ltung ba'i rnam bshad 'khrul spong rab gsal/ mngon byang bzhi bshad/ 'khor 'das dbyer med gsal byed/ brda don gsal ba'i khrid/ lam sbas bshad kyi khrid gsang ba'i lam zab mtshan bcas/ gā ya'i mgon rkyang rjes gnang la sogs pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar/ kun spangs rdo ring pa chen po'i rnam thar/ lam 'bras brgyud 'debs/ lam rim smon lam dang bcas pa/ de'i bkra shis/ dbang chu'i lhan thabs/ phyi dkyil gyi rnam bshad/ nang dkyil gyi rnam bshad la sogs pa ste/ de rnams kyang tshad ma bzhi dang sbyar te shes par sla'o/ /bzhi pa snyan brgyud bzhi'i sgro 'dogs gcod tshul la gnyis/ thun mong ba tshogs bshad kyi dbang du byas pa dang / thun mong min pa slob bshad kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po la bzhi/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gdams ngag gi sarka ma log pa/ mos gus kyis bsam pa tshim pa'o/ /dang po la'ang gsum/ rgyu dus kyi dbang chu ma nub pa ni/ sdom pa rtsa ba nas ma nyams pa/ lam dus kyi dbang chu ma nub pa ni/ lam dbang thob nas rab 'bring gsum du ma chad pa/ 'bras bu'i dbang chu ma nub pa ni/ 'gros bzhi thims pa'i rten 'brel ma 'chugs pa'o/ /byin rlabs la'ang bzhi/ nyams su blang ba'i mtha' ni lus gnad bca' ba nas/ gegs sel gyi bar bla ma'i gsung bzhin nyams su blangs pa/ byin rlabs kyi mtha' ni phyi nang mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa/ nyams su myong ba'i mtha' ni/ nyams ji lta ba bzhin skyes pa/ grub pa'i mtha' ni grub mtha' snyogs pa'o/ /sarka ma log pa ni/ sarka'am/ sarwa'am/ sarga'am gang byas kyang 'dra ste/ go rim gyi brda rnying yin la/ de nas gdams ngag ston pa'i go rim ltar na/ rgyud ma sbyangs pa la dbang mi bskur/

de ma bskur ba la khrid mi byed/ de ma byas pa la gzhung mi bshad/ de ma bshad pa la sgrub lung mi sbyin/ de ma sbyin pa la gsang bcu yis rgyas mi gdab pa'o/ /nyams myong la nyams snang thams cad rtsa yi ge dang de'i rten 'brel du shes pas re dogs dang bral ba'o/ /bzhi pa mos gus ni/ nyams myong nang nas shar bas/ dag pa'i snang ba rgyas te/ mos gus 'phrog par mi nus pa'o/ /gnyis pa slob bshad ni 'dir mi 'bri ste/ thun mong ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /da ni khrid kyi gzhung shing bye brag tu bshad pa la 'di skad ces gsungs te/ de yang / dkri rgyu'i gang zag ngos bzung ba/ khrid byed rnal 'byor ngos bzung ba/ gzhung shing bzhi nyid khyad par du bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dkri rgyu'i gang zag thams cad ni/ skal dman rim gyis pa dang / skal ldan cig car ba gnyis su 'du la/ de gnyis mngon byung la sbyar na nag po pa dang / ḍoṃ bhi pa gnyis la go rim ltar ngos 'dzin zhing / da ltar la sbyar na/ spyir gang zag bzhi ste/ gsang sngags la zhugs pa dang / theg chen tsam la zhugs pa dang / nyan thos tsam la zhugs pa dang / bstan pa la ma zhugs pa'o/ /phyi ma la gsum/ tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi go 'phang 'dod pa dang / rang nyid gcig po zhi ba don gnyer tsam dang / tshe 'dir nad zhi gdon zhi tsam 'dod pa'o/ /de ltar gsum gyi snga ma ni/ skal ldan cig car ba dang / phyi ma ni skal dman rim 'jug pa'i dper gzung bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa khrid kyi rnal 'byor la gsum/ rgyud las gsungs tshul/ thun mong ba'i man ngag gis bkral tshul/ thun mong min pa'i man ngag gis bkral tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis las/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de nas bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid/ /de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas/

/de rjes kyai yi rdo rje stsal/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ljon shing las/ rim pas slob tshul la/ thun mong ba'i lam la slob tshul dang / thun mong min pa'i lam la slob tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ spyod pa rim can dang / lta ba rim can la slob tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ gso sbyong dang / gnas bcu ste/ gtan khrims la slob pa/ gnyis pa ni grub mtha' bzhi la slob pa'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong min pa ni/ rgyud sde bzhi la rim pas slob cing / bla med kyi'ang / pha rgyud/ ma rgyud gnyis med rgyud rtsa bshad la legs par 'jug pa'o/ /de dag don dril na/ dang por gso sbyong phog de nas skyabs 'gro gtan khrims bdun/ sems bskyed rnams gzhir bzung nas/ lta ba sgro 'dogs gcod pa sogs ljon shing nyid las ji ltar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa thun mong min pa'i nyams len ni/ gzhung chung rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'dis legs par bkral pa 'di nyid de/ 'di la'ang gnyis/ gzhung chung bstan bcos tshad ma rang gang gi bzhugs tshul ltar bshad pa dang / gzhung chung bla ma'i man ngag gis nyams myong tshad mar drangs te bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshig rkang gi don 'khor 'das thun mong ba la gzhung tshom bu bdun/ 'khor lo 'cham pa la tshom bu bdun/ 'khor lo bskor ba la tshom bu bzhi ste/ tshom bu bco brgyad du bstan pa las/ thun mong ba'i tshom bu bdun lta bus kyang tshom bu rang rang gi lam 'bras re ston cing / de yang snang gsum lta bu la sbyar ba'i tshe/ snang ba re re la rten rgyu/ snang ba gang yin pa zhes gsum gsum gyis bshad nas/ nyams snang gi rten 'char ba'i tshe/ lus khyad du gyur pa/ thos bsam bslab pa/ dbang gis rgyud dag cing / nyams rgyud la skyes pa zhes 'chad pas/ rnal 'byor pa'i dbang dam tshig bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len thams cad 'dir bstan nas/ ma dag snang ba'i skabs su lam nyams len gyi dri mi bro ba'i bshad lugs gcig byed pa'o/

/gnyis pa ni tshig rkang gi don tshom bu ji snyed pa thams cad/ gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi cha rkyen ma tshang ba med pa gcig tu dril nas ston te/ de yang sems can la nyon mongs pa la ma dag pa'i snang ba/ zhes pas/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang bcas pa/ las rgyu 'bras rnams ston te/ sems can gyi khams la brtags pas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes/ nyon mongs pa'i mang tshul mthong bas dal 'byor rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed dka' bar go ma dag pa'i snang tshul bltas pas/ las 'bras bslu med du mthong bas so/ /rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin la nyams kyi snang ba/ zhes pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ thun mong dang / thun mong min pa gnyis su phye nas/ thun mong pas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rnams bsgom pas rgyud sbyangs te/ dbang bskur ba'i snod rung du byas/ lus thabs rgyud la gdan sogs gsum pa bzhis rgyu'i dbang zhes pas rgyu dbang bskur ba sogs gang zag gcig gi nyams len du sbyar nas 'chad pa'o/ /de ltar tshad ma gnyis la sbyor tshul tha dad pa'i rnam dbyes/ rdo rje'i tshig la bshad pa dang / nyams len gnyis tha dad par 'byung ba ni/ man ngag gi mig gis bltas na gsal bar mthong ste/ rnam 'grel mnyag ma sogs na bstan bcos tshad ma'i bshad pa de nyid bsnyon med du yod cing / nyams myong tshad ma la sbyar ba'i nyams len 'di nyid ni/ rnam 'grel a seng ma dang / gzhung khrid jo lcags ma gnyis na gsal ba yin te/ ji skad du/ snang ba gsum gyis lam gyi gzhi bcas te/ /zhes pa snang gsum gyi nyams len te/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' go las 'bras lhur len/ byams snying rje byang sems rnams kyis rgyud sbyangs pa ni/ dbang gi snod dam gzhir rung bas/ lam gyi gzhi ma yin pa'o/ /nyams blang ma lus rgyud gsum dag gis shes/ /zhes pa ni/ rgyud gsum nyams blang ni/

dngos gzhir bstan pa ste/ de yang kun gzhi ni gtan la dbab bya yin yang / yul can 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi cha nas nyams blang du bsdus/ 'bras rgyud ni spro ba bskyed pa'i cha nas sam/ 'bras bu'i nyams sna tshogs 'char bas der bsdus pa tsam ste/ gtso bo thabs rgyu sde/ dang po dbang / bsrung bya dam tshig bsgom bya lam sogs nyams chag bskang thabs lam dus dbang la sogs pa'o/ /tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi yis sgro 'dogs gcod/ /ces pa ni/ sgro 'dogs gcod yul te/ tshad ma bzhis snang gsum dang / snyan rgyud bzhis rgyud gsum la'o/ /sems 'dzin gnas lugs rnam gsum rtogs pa yi zhes pa nas/ rgyu rkyen gzhan med re dogs bral bar mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis zhes pas phan 'dogs bdun bstan/ thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug rnal 'byor pa/ /zhes pa nas/ bar chad rim gyis sel bar shes par bya zhes pa'i bar gyis srung ba sum cu bstan/ rtsa yi zug la la dor shin tu gces/ /zhes sogs kyis gegs sel bstan/ lta sgom gnyis la dug dbyung bdud rtsi sten/ /zhes sogs kyis gdams ngag drug bstan te/ mdor na gzhung 'dis tshom bu thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du bril nas bstan pas/ bstan bcos tshad mar bgrang yang / ston tshul nyams myong tshad mar bzhugs so zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa khrid kyi gzhung shing bye brag tu bshad pa'ang gnyis/ spyir bshad pa dang / gnad bsdus nas nyams su len tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gang dag chos rje pa'i khrid kyi dkar chag tu grags pa de'i rjes su zhugs nas/ khrid tshul bco brgyad du byed pa yod mod/ re zhig btang snyoms bzhag nas/ 'dir brgyud pa 'di nyid las 'ongs pa ni/ khrid gzhung bzhir grags pa dang / cha lag lam sbas bshad/ brda don gsal ba rnams kyi khrid mdzad la/ lam zab mo la'ang khrid med do zhes bka' dog par mdzad kyang / khrid zab po gcig bzhugs zhes gsungs shing /

khrid gzhung bzhi'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin gyi khrid kyis bkris na/ khrid gzhan gsum gyis logs su bkri mi dgos te/ lam dbang rgyas pa thob na/ 'bring bsdus gnyis logs su bya mi dgos pa dang 'dra gsungs/ de yang khrid thog mtha' gnyis rgyas pa/ bar pa gnyis bsdus pa/ yang thog ma skal dman rim 'jug pa'i khrid de/ tshig rkang gi babs kyis gzhung tshul ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'o/ /bar pa gnyis ni skal ldan cig char ba'i khrid de/ gnad drug gis bkri ba ni/ bskyed rdzogs thun mong ba'i khrid yin la/ gnad bcu gcig gis bkri ba ni/ rdzogs rim kho na'i khrid yin pa'o/ /dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyis bkri ba ni/ cig car ba dang rim 'jug pa thun mong ba'i khrid yin pas/ ji ltar 'tsham pas bkri zhing rgyud tshod sbyar ba ste/ nyan thos lam gyis bkri bar 'os pa ni/ nyes dmigs rnyed dka' las 'bras gsum gyis bkri/ theg pa thun mong bas bkri bar 'os pa ni/ byams snying rje byang sems gsum gyis bkri/ thun mong min pa lta bas bkri bar 'os pa ni/ sems sgyu ma rang bzhin med pa gsum gyis bkri/ thabs shes rab/ zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor pa gsum ni/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum gsum du phye nas bkri ba'o/ /de lta bu'i dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi khrid yig 'di la/ sngon yig rnying che chung gnyis 'dug pa las/ brgyud pa 'di pas tshad ma bya rgyu ni chung ba 'di nyid de/ 'di nyid tshad ma yin pa'i shes byed ni/ dkar shākya grags kyi 'di'i khrid yig dang / tshogs sgom pa'i 'di'i khrid yig dang 'di nyid mthun pas yin la/ cha gan pa'i yi ge dang yang 'di mthun pa yin no/ /khrid yig che ba de nyid ni/ sa paṇa khrid kyi dkar chag tu grags pa las/ de nyid gzhir bzhag pa nas chos rje bla ma dam pa sogs kyis kyang tshad mar mdzad mod/ cung ma dag pa'i shes byed ni/ sngon 'gro dmigs pa'i grangs zlos pa dang /

sems kyi dpe mig yor dang / rten 'brel gyi dpe chu zla gnyis sgyu ma'i dper bkod pas rje pa'i gsung dang 'gal/ zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor gyi khrid rim chad/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang tsam thob pas lus dkyil 'khor bsgom du rung bar bshad pa sogs gong ma'i gsung rab dad 'gal bar snang ba du ma zhig yod pa'o gsungs/ /gnyis pa gnad bsdus nas nyams su blang ba ni/ lam 'bras khrid kyi snying po ni/ /gnyis las gsum byung gdams ngag yin/ /kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i/ /man ngag shes pa bla ma'i drin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / yang de nyid dang mthun par/ bshad tshul 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i dgongs pa yin mod kyi/ /deng sang lam 'bras pa zhes yongs grags pa'i/ /bshes gnyen kun gyis lta ba'i spyod yul min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don khong du bcud nas don nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /'o na de nyid kyi don ci yin snyam na/ 'di'i don ni/ drin can bla ma legs par mnyes pa'i zhal las rim gyis shes par bya ba kho na yin pas/ ci tol du yi ger 'bri ba dang / gtam du smra ba'i 'os ma yin pa de bas na/ 'dir mi 'bri la/ gang dag brgyud ldan bla ma'i zhal shes kyi bdud rtsi yid la sim pa'i skal ba dang ldan na nas/ rang dga'i pho tshod ngan skyugs kyis/ yid gdung sel du/ dur re ba mang du mngon te/ rgyud pa nye rgyud gnyis rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi gdams ngag byung zhes smra ba dang / khrid yig lhug pa jo lcags ma dang / tshigs bcad ma gra ston zhus lan gnyis las/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi gdam ngag byung / zhes smra ba dang / brda don gsal ba rtsa 'grel gnyis las/ dmigs pa rgyas 'bring bsdus kyi gdams ngag byung zhes/ gnyis dang gsum gyi khungs gang 'grig btsal nas 'ol tshod kyis gzhal bar mdzad pa'o/ /de ltar min par brgyud pa'i man ngag snyan rgyud ma nyams pa 'dir ni/

rje btsun bla mas/ khog phug yongs su rdzogs pa'i dus 'dir/ rgyud rim gyi zhal shes nyid gsungs la/ khrid rim yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe man ngag gi zhal shes nyid 'doms par mdzad do zhes gsungs pa'o/ /gsum pa bsgrub pa mthar phyin pas gsang ba bcu'i rgyas btab pa ni/ de ltar rgyud sbyangs pa la dbang / dbang gis smin pa la khrid/ bkris tshar ba la gzhung chung gdams ngag tu ston/ gzhung tshar ba la ji ltar 'os pa'i bka' rgya ma 'ongs pa'i lung bstan dang bcas pas gdams par mdzad pa ste/ de ltar de dag gis ni khog phub kyi gnad spyi bye brag rkang grangs dang bcas pa/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang 'dzin pa blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ brgyud pa gsum 'dus kyi bla ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi tshim par phab pa'i mdo las/ cha shas 'di tsam zhig bdag blo'i ra bar chud pa/ ngan rtogs dug chus ma sbags par/ rang gi tsha gdung bsal ba'i phyir/ dkar dwangs kyi gzhi la gsal bar bkod pa ste/ skal ba dang 'tsham na re 'dod yongs su rdzogs pa kho na yin no/ /blo gsal smra mkhas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir snyan brgyud 'di la khyod min mkhas dang grub pa gang / /rgya mtsho'i gos can phyogs mthar son kyang 'di ni 'di zhes rig par ldan nas smra ba su/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor phyin nas 'dod rgu'i dpal gyis bdag blo 'tsho ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /bzang po'i spyod tshul mchog gis bsten no bslu med thugs rjes 'bral ba med par bdag skyongs shig /blo gsal mang du thos pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /bsgom pa rlabs bral rgya mtsho'i don rnyed pa/ /'di na grags pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bzhugs te/ /dpal 'byor bzang po'i char 'bebs gang 'dir bstod/ /nam yang shes bya'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /mi rtag 'chi ba'i tshul 'di'ang yang yang dran/ /dam pa'i gsung ngag bdud rtsi 'di 'thungs nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su bsam gtan bsgom par shog

/snyan rgyud bzhi ldan mkha' 'gro'i gdam ngag 'di/ /chos brgyad rkyen gyis kha nas ma lhung bar/ /blo kha nang du phyogs pa'i nyams len gyis/ /sgro 'dogs nang nas chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /don med rtsod pas rang gzhan mi bsreg par/ /don dam gnad la 'dris pa'i 'bel gtam gyis/ /rdo rje bla ma rdo rje'i spun grogs sogs/ /dges pas rtogs pa 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rab bsnyen mtha' ru 'khyol ba'i gdeng tshad kyis/ /rang nyid mi slu'i gnas su ma sleb bar/ /gzugs brnyan gzhan gyis rang gzhan mi bslu bar/ /rtse gcig rang mgo 'don par byin gyis rlobs/ /bshad tshod gad rgyangs bsgrags pa'i 'ol spyi yis/ /chos kun gtan la dbab par ci mkhas kyang / /rkyen ngan byung tshe phan par mi 'dug pas na/ /dus nam rtag tu zab don bsgom par shog /sgom pa la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /nyams rtogs kun gong 'phel du rgyas pa'i rgyu/ /rten 'brel kun rang sar 'grigs pa dang / /tshad ma bzhi rang rgyud la 'byor bar shog /blo gsal gyi slob bshad nor bu 'di/ /klu dbang kho'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu spras/ /sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /yun ring du 'phel zhing gnas par shog /blo gsal ded dpon mkhas pa'i tshogs kun/ /bla chen gsung gi rgya mtsho 'di ni/ /legs byed yid bzhin nor bu yod kyi/ /rtse gcig dad pas tshul bzhin longs shig /blo gsal nam mkha'i nor bu 'di shar/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can snang bas khyab bo/ /skal med 'byung po'i 'dab chags tshogs kun/ /byang du kha bltas phug par bros shig /e ma ho/ blo gsal gnyis skyes gzhon nu/ /khog phug 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'di na/ /sngon med 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal 'khrungs kyis/ /dges pas lding zhing bcud la rol cig /blo gsal bla ma'i mkhyen yangs rgya mtshor/ /legs 'khrungs gsung ngag khog phub chu skyes/ /skyon bral nyi 'od bdag blo zhan pas/
